title: Do Oil Price Shocks Help or Hurt Growth? Asymmetric Evidence from Jordan (2008-2023)
affiliations: University of Jordan

detail.title: Do Oil Price Shocks Help or Hurt Growth? Asymmetric Evidence from Jordan (2008-2023)
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether oil price increases and decreases affect economic growth symmetrically in a net oil-importing economy, using Jordan as a case study over 2008Q2-2023Q3. Quarterly real GDP growth is paired with Brent crude prices, and oil shocks are constructed as log changes and decomposed into positive and negative components following Mork (1989). The relationship is estimated using OLS with four quarterly lags, complemented by a general-to-specific (GETS) reduction and standard diagnostic and stability checks. The results show a positive and statistically significant association between aggregate oil shocks and growth (about 0.03%), while positive oil shocks are not statistically significant. In contrast, negative oil shocks exhibit a positive and statistically significant effect on growth (about 0.05%), indicating an asymmetric growth response to oil price movements in Jordan. Policy implications emphasize leveraging periods of declining oil prices to support priority investment spending, stimulate private investment in less oil-sensitive sectors, and accelerate investment in energy alternatives and renewables, supported by a dedicated governmental unit to monitor and forecast global oil prices.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验了油价上涨和下跌对约旦经济增长的对称性影响，发现存在不对称效应：总体油价冲击对增长有正向影响（约0.03%），而油价上涨冲击不显著，油价下跌冲击则有显著正向影响（约0.05%）。
AI.research_question: 油价上涨和下跌对净石油进口经济体的经济增长是否产生对称性影响？
AI.motivation: 理解油价变动对经济增长的影响对政策制定至关重要，特别是对于约旦这样的净石油进口国，需要了解油价上涨和下跌是否对经济产生对称性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Mork（1989）的油价冲击分解方法，将油价冲击分解为正向（上涨）和负向（下跌）分量，检验其对经济增长的不对称效应。
AI.method: 使用2008Q2-2023Q3的季度数据，将实际GDP增长率与布伦特原油价格配对，采用OLS回归（含四个季度滞后），辅以一般到特定（GETS）缩减方法，并进行标准诊断和稳定性检验。
AI.findings:
1. 总体油价冲击对经济增长有正向显著影响（约0.03%）
2. 正向油价冲击（油价上涨）对经济增长影响不显著
3. 负向油价冲击（油价下跌）对经济增长有正向显著影响（约0.05%）
表明约旦经济增长对油价变动存在不对称响应
AI.theory_contributions: 为油价冲击与经济增长关系的不对称性理论提供了实证支持，特别是在净石油进口经济体的背景下，验证了Mork（1989）的油价冲击分解方法的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策建议：利用油价下跌时期支持优先投资支出，刺激石油敏感度较低行业的私人投资，加速能源替代和可再生能源投资，并建立专门政府单位监测和预测全球油价。

title: Methods to Tailor Behavioural Interventions: A Systematic Review of Categorisation Approaches in (Energy) Economics
affiliations: , University College Dublin, Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt,  and

detail.title: Methods to Tailor Behavioural Interventions: A Systematic Review of Categorisation Approaches in (Energy) Economics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by the Dutch Research Council (NWO): NWA.1389.20.251.

detail.abstract: Transitioning to clean energy is necessary to meet the climate targets of the Paris Agreement. Accelerating decarbonisation requires improving energy efficiency and making large-scale green energy investments, inter alia in residential homes. Household energy behaviours and investment decisions are mostly suboptimal as individuals often face significant psychological barriers and are subjected to cognitive biases. Consequently, one-size-fits-all interventions, that are aimed at fostering green energy behaviours, lead to information overload and rebound effects, thereby being inefficient. A growing proposition in behavioural sciences is to personalise the delivery of behavioural interventions (BIs) to facilitate the uptake of energy-efficient behaviours. This is typically done, for example, by tailoring different BIs to individuals to overcome individual biases in the adoption of green appliances and renovations. Nonetheless, there is no clear know-how to use different statistical methods to tailor BIs. While researchers rely on various techniques to customise BIs for specific groups, this segmentation process lacks coherence overall. In this paper, we systematically review and sort the literature on statistical classification and clustering models, including machine learning methods, that have been used to optimise BIs for improving residential energy efficiency. Our review provides a holistic overview of these different methods, along with recommendations for practitioners to use them. It further highlights the role that machine learning algorithms can play in automating BIs, for example, by using sophisticated data analysis and pattern recognition to identify intricate relationships between decision-making factors. These insights can lead to highly optimised personalised strategies for increased energy efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了用于优化住宅能源效率行为干预的统计分类和聚类模型（包括机器学习方法），为实践者提供方法选择建议，并强调机器学习在自动化行为干预中的作用。
AI.research_question: 如何有效使用统计分类和聚类模型（包括机器学习方法）来优化住宅能源效率的行为干预？

AI.theoretical_framework: 行为科学理论（心理障碍、认知偏差）、个性化行为干预理论、统计分类与聚类理论、机器学习理论

title: When Equilibrium Exists but Cannot Be Implemented
affiliations: and Texas Tech University

detail.title: When Equilibrium Exists but Cannot Be Implemented
detail.abstract: Classical equilibrium theory guarantees the existence of equilibrium under minimal assumptions on preferences and technology. These results, however, implicitly presume that economic agents can compute and implement equilibrium actions without cognitive or computational constraints. This paper revisits the equilibrium concept by explicitly incorporating finite computational rationality. We define an Implementable Competitive Equilibrium (ICE) as a competitive equilibrium supported by decentralized polynomial-time decision procedures that map market signals (prices and endowments) into exact Walrasian demands. We show that there exist competitive economies with standard convexity/continuity properties but implicitly described feasibility constraints in which an Arrow-Debreu equilibrium exists, yet no ICE exists under any reasonable computational constraint. The impossibility result arises not from behavioral frictions, information imperfections, or approximation, but from the intrinsic computational hardness of individual optimization and consistency conditions under compact representations. Our findings suggest that equilibrium existence alone is insufficient for economic relevance and call for a reconsideration of equilibrium as an implementable object rather than a purely mathematical construct.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了经典均衡理论，指出虽然数学上存在均衡，但实际中经济主体可能因计算复杂性而无法实现均衡。论文提出了"可实施竞争均衡"概念，证明在某些经济中存在数学均衡但无可实施均衡，表明均衡存在性不足以保证经济相关性。
AI.research_question: 在考虑有限计算理性的情况下，竞争均衡是否仍然存在？当经济主体面临计算复杂性约束时，经典均衡理论中的均衡概念是否仍然具有经济相关性？
AI.motivation: 经典均衡理论假设经济主体能够无成本地计算和实施均衡行为，忽略了认知和计算约束。现实中，经济主体面临有限的计算能力和时间，这可能导致即使数学上存在均衡，实际中也无法实现。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 经典竞争均衡理论（Arrow-Debreu均衡）
2. 计算复杂性理论
3. 有限理性理论
4. 可实施竞争均衡（ICE）概念：要求均衡由分散化的多项式时间决策程序支持
AI.method: 理论分析/证明方法：通过构造具有标准凸性/连续性性质但包含隐含描述可行性约束的经济体，证明存在Arrow-Debreu均衡但无可实施竞争均衡的情况。
AI.findings:
1. 存在具有标准性质的经济体，其中Arrow-Debreu均衡存在，但在任何合理的计算约束下都不存在可实施竞争均衡
2. 不可能性结果源于个体优化和一致性条件在紧凑表示下的内在计算困难
3. 这种不可能性不是由行为摩擦、信息不完善或近似引起的，而是计算复杂性本身
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"可实施竞争均衡"新概念，将计算理性纳入均衡分析
2. 证明了均衡存在性不足以保证经济相关性
3. 挑战了经典均衡理论的基本假设，为计算经济学提供了新视角
4. 表明均衡应被视为可实施对象而非纯粹数学构造
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提醒政策制定者：数学上存在的均衡可能在实践中无法实现
2. 为经济机制设计提供新考量：需要考虑主体的计算能力限制
3. 对市场设计和监管有启示意义：应关注均衡的可实施性而不仅仅是存在性
4. 为理解现实经济现象提供了计算复杂性视角

title: Attention is Money: How Digital Distraction Makes Retail Investors Take More Risks

detail.title: Attention is Money: How Digital Distraction Makes Retail Investors Take More Risks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known personal or financial conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a conceptual and theoretical analysis based on existing literature and does not involve human participants, primary data collection, experiments, or identifiable personal data. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Today's investment apps use games and social media to get people to trade. This causes a problem for old ideas about how smart people make financial decisions. Traditional finance thinks investors can fully focus and process all information, but modern digital life makes it hard for people to focus. This paper looks at how attention, which we call a valuable type of psychological resource, affects how much risk investors take on distracting, easy-to-use digital platforms. We use ideas from Kahneman and Tversky's prospect theory, along with current ideas about constant partial attention. The main mental problems we study are: 1) a stronger "availability heuristic" (where you believe things happen more often because you see them a lot) caused by social media, and 2) how distracting design stops the necessary deep thinking ('System 2' processing) needed to research investments. We find that always seeing quick, big-win stories makes investors wrongly think that big, unlikely rewards are more probable. This constant lack of focus changes how investors decide on risk. The result is that regulators need to quickly look at how platforms are designed, especially features that use up limited focus to make regular investors trade more often and take bigger risks.

AI.tldr: 现代投资应用通过游戏化和社交媒体设计吸引用户交易，这挑战了传统金融理论中理性投资者的假设。研究发现，数字平台上的注意力分散和社交媒体的可得性启发式偏差导致投资者高估小概率大收益的可能性，从而承担过度风险。
AI.research_question: 注意力作为一种稀缺心理资源如何影响投资者在分散注意力的数字平台上承担风险的行为？
AI.motivation: 传统金融理论假设投资者能够完全专注并处理所有信息，但现代数字生活使人们难以保持专注。投资应用通过游戏化和社交媒体设计吸引用户交易，这需要重新审视注意力对投资决策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Kahneman和Tversky的前景理论，结合现代持续部分注意力的概念。主要关注两个心理机制：1) 社交媒体强化的可得性启发式偏差；2) 分散注意力的设计阻碍了投资研究所需的深度思考（系统2处理）。
AI.method: 论文未明确说明具体研究方法，但从内容推断可能采用理论分析框架，结合行为金融学理论和数字平台设计特征的分析。
AI.findings: 持续看到快速、大额收益的故事使投资者错误地认为小概率大收益事件更可能发生。注意力分散改变了投资者的风险决策过程，导致他们承担过度风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将注意力概念化为稀缺心理资源，整合前景理论与持续部分注意力理论，为理解数字时代投资行为提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 监管机构需要紧急审视平台设计，特别是那些消耗有限注意力资源、促使普通投资者更频繁交易和承担更大风险的功能设计。

title: Stablecoins and Tokenized Assets: Impact on Derivatve Counterparty Credit Risk

detail.title: Stablecoins and Tokenized Assets: Impact on Derivatve Counterparty Credit Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not Applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: No Applicable

detail.abstract:
The increasing use of payment stablecoins for payments and settlements in financial transactions and the tokenization of financial assets, presents new opportunities for efficiency, especially when these assets are employed as collateral in derivative transactions. These technological advancements can significantly reduce delays in three critical areas: the valuation of collateral, the process of posting and receiving collateral, and the final settlement of collateral. As a result of these accelerated processes, the margin period of risk (MPOR)—the period in which the value of collateral and the value of the reference portfolio may move apart—is expected to decline. A shorter MPOR indicates that the gap between the value of the portfolio and its collateral at any point, including at the time of default, becomes smaller. This compression of the MPOR leads to a reduction in widely used measures of counterparty credit risk exposure, such as exposure at default and the credit valuation adjustment (CVA). Ultimately, these changes promote stronger risk management practices and enhance overall market efficiency.

For example, if payment stablecoins—backed one-for-one by assets like cash or U.S. Treasuries as required under the 2025 Genius Act—are accepted as eligible financial collateral for over-the-counter (OTC) derivative transactions, standard MPOR thresholds (such as the typical 10 business days for OTC derivatives) may be reconsidered and potentially reduced to better reflect these operational improvements.

This paper examines various scenarios illustrating the impact of using payment stablecoins and tokenized financial assets on counterparty credit risk exposure, considering different assumptions for the MPOR. Estimates suggest that shortening the MPOR from 10 business days to 5 business days could decrease counterparty credit risk in derivative transactions by as much as 29%. Such a reduction would provide substantial capital efficiencies for U.S. Global Systemically Important Banks (G-SIBs).

AI.tldr: 本文研究支付稳定币和资产代币化如何通过缩短保证金风险期(MPOR)来降低衍生品交易中的对手方信用风险。研究发现将MPOR从10个工作日缩短到5个工作日可减少29%的信用风险，为全球系统重要性银行带来显著的资本效率提升。
AI.research_question: 支付稳定币和金融资产代币化如何影响衍生品交易中的对手方信用风险暴露？特别是通过缩短保证金风险期(MPOR)能带来多大的风险降低效果？
AI.motivation: 金融科技发展带来的支付稳定币和资产代币化为金融交易提供了新的效率机会，特别是在衍生品交易中作为抵押品使用时。这些技术进步可以显著减少抵押品估值、提交接收和最终结算三个关键环节的延迟，从而缩短保证金风险期，降低信用风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于对手方信用风险管理理论，特别是保证金风险期(MPOR)概念，以及相关的风险度量指标如违约风险暴露(EAD)和信用估值调整(CVA)。
AI.method: 采用情景分析方法，研究不同MPOR假设下使用支付稳定币和代币化金融资产对对手方信用风险的影响。通过量化模型估计风险减少程度。
AI.findings: 将MPOR从10个工作日缩短到5个工作日可将衍生品交易中的对手方信用风险降低多达29%。这种风险减少为美国全球系统重要性银行(G-SIBs)带来了显著的资本效率提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融科技对信用风险管理的影响提供了理论框架，特别是量化了技术进步通过缩短MPOR对信用风险暴露的具体影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构重新考虑OTC衍生品交易的MPOR阈值提供了实证依据；为金融机构采用稳定币和代币化资产作为抵押品提供了风险降低的量化证据；有助于促进更有效的风险管理和市场效率提升。

title: The Conceptual Foundations of Self-Control and its Link to Impulsivity and Attention
affiliations: School of Economics, University of Sydney, The University of Sydney, The University of Sydney - School of Economics and Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT) University

detail.title: The Conceptual Foundations of Self-Control and its Link to Impulsivity and Attention

declarations.ethicsApproval: Our experimental protocol was approved by The University of Sydney Human Research Ethics Committee (project no. 2021/865 approved on 05/04/2022). We pre-registered our experimental design and analysis plan at Open Science Framework (available at https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/XWSJ6 on June 18th, 2024 prior to data collection).

detail.abstract: Self-control, attention, and impulsivity jointly support goal-directed behavior yet are often examined in isolation with heterogeneous measures. We integrate validated self-reported scales with a hybrid, incentivized behavioral task that synthesizes two canonical experimental designs and adds novel extensions to measure these constructs in a typical work context. Using data from a preregistered four-session online study (N = 443 adults), we characterize the cross-relationships and the relationships between different measures of self-control, attention, and impulsivity and evaluate their contributions to effort allocation over time. More broadly, the study advances an emerging research program that leverages laboratory settings with well-structured economic incentives to examine the role of personality traits and cognitive limitations in economic decision making.

AI.tldr: 该研究整合了自我报告量表和行为任务，在典型工作情境中测量自我控制、注意力和冲动性，并分析它们对努力分配的影响。
AI.research_question: 自我控制、注意力和冲动性如何相互关联，以及它们如何共同影响随时间变化的努力分配？
AI.motivation: 自我控制、注意力和冲动性通常被孤立研究且测量方法各异，需要整合这些构念并在典型工作情境中考察它们对目标导向行为的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合人格特质（自我控制、冲动性）和认知能力（注意力）的理论框架，结合经济学决策理论，研究这些因素如何影响努力分配。
AI.method: 采用预注册的四阶段在线研究（N=443名成人），整合已验证的自我报告量表与混合激励行为任务，该任务综合了两种经典实验设计并增加了新扩展。
AI.findings: 揭示了自我控制、注意力和冲动性之间的交叉关系，以及它们与不同测量方法之间的关系，并评估了这些构念对随时间变化的努力分配的贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了利用实验室设置和结构化经济激励来研究人格特质和认知局限在经济决策中作用的新兴研究项目。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了在典型工作情境中测量自我控制、注意力和冲动性的综合方法，有助于理解这些因素如何影响实际工作中的努力分配和绩效。

title: The Impact of State-Level R&D Incentives Versus Educational Attainment on Innovation
affiliations: Providence College

detail.title: The Impact of State-Level R&D Incentives Versus Educational Attainment on Innovation
detail.abstract: The 2025 One Big Beautiful Bill Act included a provision allowing for immediate expensing of research and development (R&D) expenditures. States are deciding whether they should match this change or retain their current R&D write-off policy. This paper uses state-level panel data from 2013 to 2019 to examine whether state extramural R&D expenditure or educational attainment has a more economically significant association with innovation, proxied by annual state-level patent counts. Using a year fixed-effects negative binomial regression model, the results suggest that, while both variables have a statistically significant positive relationship with patent counts, educational attainment has a more economically significant relationship than state extramural R&D expenditure.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2013-2019年州级面板数据，通过负二项回归分析发现，虽然州外部研发支出和教育程度都与专利数量显著正相关，但教育程度的经济显著性更强。
AI.research_question: 在州级层面，外部研发支出和教育程度哪个因素与创新（以专利数量为代理变量）的经济显著性关联更强？
AI.motivation: 2025年《One Big Beautiful Bill Act》允许研发支出立即费用化，各州需要决定是否匹配这一政策变化。研究旨在为政策制定提供实证依据，帮助各州评估不同政策选择对创新的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创新经济学理论，研发投入和人力资本（教育程度）都是创新的重要驱动因素。研究比较这两类因素对创新的相对重要性。
AI.method: 使用2013-2019年美国州级面板数据，采用年份固定效应负二项回归模型，以年度州级专利数量为因变量，州外部研发支出和教育程度为主要自变量。
AI.findings: 1. 州外部研发支出和教育程度都与专利数量存在统计显著的正向关系；2. 教育程度与专利数量的经济显著性关联比州外部研发支出更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 为创新驱动因素研究提供了州级层面的实证证据，强调了人力资本（教育程度）相对于研发支出的相对重要性，丰富了创新经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各州政策制定提供指导：在考虑是否匹配联邦研发支出立即费用化政策时，应更重视教育投资，因为教育对创新的促进作用可能比直接的研发支出更显著。

title: The Impact of Weather on U.S. Agricultural Capacity Utilization: A Multiple-Output Nonparametric Analysis
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Impact of Weather on U.S. Agricultural Capacity Utilization: A Multiple-Output Nonparametric Analysis
detail.abstract: This study uses a state-level dataset from 1960 to 2015 and employs a nonparametric data envelopment analysis (DEA) approach to investigate how weather conditions affect agricultural capacity utilization. We estimate capacity utilization using a short-run ray average cost minimization model within a production technology framework that incorporates multiple outputs (Crops, Livestock and products, and Farm related output) produced from multiple variable inputs and multiple fixed inputs (Capital, and Land), following the method introduced by Ray, Walden, and Chen (2021). The findings indicate that most states operated below full capacity and exhibit systematic regional patterns. A second-stage two-way fixed effect model reveals that weather conditions significantly contribute to the shortfall in capacity utilization.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用1960-2015年美国州级数据，采用非参数数据包络分析（DEA）方法，在包含多种产出和投入的生产技术框架下，通过短期射线平均成本最小化模型估计农业产能利用率，发现大多数州未达到满负荷运营且存在系统性区域模式，天气条件是产能利用率不足的重要因素。
AI.research_question: 天气条件如何影响农业产能利用率？
AI.motivation: 理解农业产能利用不足的原因，特别是天气条件对农业生产效率的影响，对于制定有效的农业政策和应对气候变化具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Ray, Walden和Chen（2021）提出的生产理论框架，采用短期射线平均成本最小化模型，在包含多种产出（作物、畜牧及相关产品）和多种投入（可变投入和固定投入如资本、土地）的生产技术下分析产能利用率。
AI.method: 1. 使用1960-2015年美国州级面板数据；2. 采用非参数数据包络分析（DEA）方法；3. 基于短期射线平均成本最小化模型估计产能利用率；4. 第二阶段使用双向固定效应模型分析天气条件对产能利用率的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 大多数州农业运营未达到满负荷产能；2. 产能利用率存在系统性区域模式；3. 天气条件显著影响产能利用率，是导致产能利用不足的重要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将天气条件纳入农业产能利用率的分析框架；2. 验证了Ray等人（2021）提出的生产理论框架在农业领域的适用性；3. 为理解气候因素对农业生产效率的影响提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供关于天气条件影响农业产能的具体证据；2. 有助于制定针对性的农业气候适应政策；3. 为农业风险管理提供决策支持；4. 揭示了区域差异，有助于制定差异化的区域农业政策。

title: Ad-driven Quality Degradation on E-commerce Platforms: A Theory and Empirical Strategy
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Ad-driven Quality Degradation on E-commerce Platforms: A Theory and Empirical Strategy
detail.abstract: We develop a formal theory of how paid visibility (advertising and paid ranking) on multi-sided e-commerce platforms can drive a systemic shift toward low-quality and falsely advertised products. Building on information asymmetry, reputation dynamics, and platform revenue incentives, we show mathematically that when platform visibility is sufficiently dominated by paid factors, the marginal return to investments in real quality and long-term reputation falls below the return to investments in short-term promotional signaling or deceptive listings. This produces a tipping threshold: above a critical paid-visibility weight, the market equilibrium is dominated by low-quality or falsely advertised sellers-a quality-reversal equilibrium. We derive conditions for the threshold, characterize comparative statics, and discuss empirical identification strategies (including image-similarity detection, event-study exploitation of platform policy changes, and difference-indifferences designs). The model yields testable predictions and direct policy implications for platform governance and regulation.

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了一个关于电商平台付费可见性（广告和付费排名）如何系统性导致低质量和虚假广告产品泛滥的正式理论模型。研究发现，当平台可见性主要由付费因素主导时，投资于真实质量和长期声誉的边际回报会低于投资于短期促销信号或欺骗性列表的回报，从而产生一个临界点，超过该点市场均衡将被低质量或虚假广告卖家主导。
AI.research_question: 电商平台的付费可见性（广告和付费排名）如何系统性导致低质量和虚假广告产品的泛滥？
AI.motivation: 电商平台上虚假广告和低质量产品泛滥的问题日益严重，而平台的付费可见性机制（如广告和付费排名）可能加剧这一问题。需要理解这些机制如何影响卖家在质量投资和欺骗性营销之间的权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、声誉动态理论、平台收入激励机制
AI.method: 建立正式的数理模型，分析付费可见性权重对市场均衡的影响，推导临界点条件，进行比较静态分析，并提出实证识别策略（包括图像相似性检测、平台政策变化的事件研究、双重差分设计）
AI.findings: 当平台可见性主要由付费因素主导时，投资真实质量和长期声誉的边际回报低于投资短期促销信号或欺骗性列表的回报。存在一个临界点（付费可见性权重阈值），超过该阈值市场均衡将被低质量或虚假广告卖家主导（质量逆转均衡）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了电商平台付费可见性导致低质量和虚假广告产品泛滥的正式理论模型；2. 识别了质量逆转均衡的临界点条件；3. 提供了比较静态分析框架；4. 提出了可检验的理论预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为平台治理和监管提供直接政策启示；2. 提出了实证识别策略（图像相似性检测、事件研究、双重差分设计）；3. 帮助平台设计更健康的可见性机制；4. 为监管机构制定平台政策提供理论依据。

title: Disequilibrium Inflation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Disequilibrium Inflation
detail.abstract: I construct a model that examines the behavior of the inflation rate considering multiple functions of money. The model demonstrates that Taylor Rules are effective when the inflation rate moves to the same direction with regard to money as a medium of exchange and a storage of value. Under deflation, these two functions of money diverge oppositely and that leads to a liquidity trap which the economy struggles to escape.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个考虑货币多重功能的通胀率模型，发现泰勒规则在货币作为交换媒介和价值储藏功能同向变动时有效，但在通货紧缩时这两个功能反向背离会导致流动性陷阱
AI.research_question: 在考虑货币多重功能（交换媒介和价值储藏）的情况下，通胀率的行为模式是什么？泰勒规则在何种条件下有效？通货紧缩如何导致流动性陷阱？
AI.motivation: 传统货币政策分析往往忽视货币的多重功能，特别是通货紧缩时期货币作为交换媒介和价值储藏功能可能出现的背离，这有助于解释流动性陷阱的形成机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币的多重功能理论（交换媒介、价值储藏）、泰勒规则、流动性陷阱理论、新凯恩斯主义货币政策框架
AI.method: 构建理论模型分析通胀率行为，考虑货币的交换媒介和价值储藏功能，分析两种功能同向和反向变动对货币政策有效性的影响
AI.findings: 1. 泰勒规则在货币作为交换媒介和价值储藏功能同向变动时有效；2. 通货紧缩时期两种功能反向背离；3. 这种背离导致流动性陷阱，经济难以摆脱
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将货币多重功能纳入通胀率分析框架；2. 解释了泰勒规则有效性的条件；3. 提供了流动性陷阱形成的新理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行制定货币政策提供更全面的分析框架；2. 帮助识别通货紧缩时期流动性陷阱的风险；3. 为应对流动性陷阱提供理论指导

title: Ethics as Compression
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Ethics as Compression

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is theoretical/methodological and uses no human-subject data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: We propose a mechanistic framework treating ethics as a compression mechanism for cognition and enforcement in complex cooperation systems. Rising cooperation complexity C induces rule explosion R, which in turn drives increases in ethical abstraction level E (principles, meta-rights, meta-procedures) to reduce decision and enforcement costs. However, institutionalization of ethics amplifies downstream capture K, nested conflicts, and rule/semantic inflation, raising conflict cost X. This triggers either meta-abstraction upgrades E ₁ or failure modes ₙ₊ (fragmentation, undergroundization, coercive resets). We formalize the loop as 16 testable laws and extend it with "risk ethics" (inoculation, budgeting, zero-risk paradox, capacity-first), explaining why overprotection can increase tail risks. We conclude with falsifiable predictions and empirical research agendas.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个机制框架，将伦理视为复杂合作系统中认知和执行的压缩机制。合作复杂性上升导致规则爆炸，进而推动伦理抽象水平提高以减少决策和执行成本。然而伦理制度化会放大下游捕获、嵌套冲突和规则/语义膨胀，增加冲突成本，触发元抽象升级或失败模式。作者形式化为16条可测试定律，并扩展了"风险伦理"概念。
AI.research_question: 伦理如何在复杂合作系统中作为认知和执行的压缩机制运作？合作复杂性、规则爆炸和伦理抽象水平之间的动态关系是什么？伦理制度化如何导致下游捕获和冲突成本增加？
AI.motivation: 随着社会合作系统日益复杂，规则数量爆炸式增长，导致决策和执行成本激增。需要理解伦理如何作为压缩机制来简化这些过程，同时也要研究伦理制度化可能带来的负面后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 伦理作为压缩机制理论；2. 合作复杂性-规则爆炸-伦理抽象动态关系；3. 伦理制度化的下游捕获理论；4. 风险伦理框架（接种、预算、零风险悖论、能力优先）；5. 16条形式化定律描述系统动态。
AI.method: 理论建模和形式化分析：提出机制框架，形式化为16条可测试定律，建立数学模型描述合作复杂性(C)、规则爆炸(R)、伦理抽象水平(E)、下游捕获(K)、冲突成本(X)之间的动态关系。
AI.findings: 1. 合作复杂性增加导致规则爆炸；2. 伦理抽象水平提高可减少决策和执行成本；3. 伦理制度化会放大下游捕获、嵌套冲突和规则/语义膨胀；4. 冲突成本增加触发元抽象升级或系统失败；5. 过度保护可能增加尾部风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出伦理作为压缩机制的新理论框架；2. 形式化合作复杂性-伦理抽象动态关系的16条定律；3. 发展风险伦理概念框架；4. 提供可证伪的预测和实证研究议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织设计伦理系统提供指导；2. 帮助政策制定者理解伦理制度化的风险；3. 提供评估伦理系统有效性的框架；4. 为风险管理中的伦理决策提供工具。

title: Geoeconomic Imperatives of Ethiopia's Quest for Red Sea Port Access: An Institutional Economics Perspective
affiliations: Oda Bultum University

detail.title: Geoeconomic Imperatives of Ethiopia's Quest for Red Sea Port Access: An Institutional Economics Perspective
detail.abstract: Ethiopia's quest for Red Sea port access exemplifies the intersection of historical legacies, legal frameworks, and contemporary geoeconomic imperatives. Since Eritrea's independence in 1993, Ethiopia's landlocked status has imposed significant transaction costs, foreign-exchange leakage, and strategic dependency on Djibouti. While prevailing narratives emphasize escalation and sovereignty disputes, this paper reframes the issue through institutional economics, highlighting rules, incentives, and governance structures as pathways to de-escalation, commercialization, and mutual benefit. By analyzing historical foundations, current claims, media narratives, and underexplored geoeconomic imperatives, the study proposes institutional pathways-contracts, escrow mechanisms, arbitration, and phased pilots-that can depoliticize maritime access and transform contested ports into engines of shared prosperity and regional stability.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过制度经济学视角分析埃塞俄比亚获取红海港口通道的问题，提出通过合同、托管机制、仲裁和试点项目等制度路径，将政治化的港口争议转化为商业合作，实现共同繁荣和区域稳定。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚如何通过制度经济学框架解决红海港口通道问题，实现去政治化、商业化和互利共赢？
AI.motivation: 埃塞俄比亚自1993年厄立特里亚独立后成为内陆国，面临高昂的交易成本、外汇流失和对吉布提的战略依赖。传统叙事强调冲突升级和主权争议，但需要新的分析框架来寻找解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学理论，强调规则、激励和治理结构在解决地缘经济问题中的作用。
AI.method: 分析历史基础、当前主张、媒体叙事和未充分探讨的地缘经济需求，提出制度解决方案。
AI.findings: 通过制度经济学视角可以发现，合同、托管机制、仲裁和分阶段试点项目等制度路径能够将港口通道问题去政治化，将争议港口转化为共享繁荣和区域稳定的引擎。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度经济学应用于地缘政治和港口通道问题，提供了超越传统冲突叙事的分析框架，强调治理结构和激励机制的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃塞俄比亚和红海地区国家提供了具体的制度解决方案，包括合同设计、托管安排、仲裁机制和试点项目，有助于实现港口通道的商业化和区域经济合作。

title: Decarbonizing a Portfolio of Operating Assets: Cost Estimates for Vehicle Fleets
affiliations: University of Mannheim - Business School, University of Mannheim and University of Mannheim - Business School

detail.title: Decarbonizing a Portfolio of Operating Assets: Cost Estimates for Vehicle Fleets

publicationDetails.detailsText: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series No. 223
publicationDetails.journalName: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Companies across industries seek to assess the costs of complying with environmental regulations and meeting voluntary emission targets. This paper develops a carbon abatement cost model for firms operating a portfolio of assets with differing cost or load profiles. The resulting abatement cost curves serve as a decision tool for configuring individual assets to achieve firm-wide emission reductions at least cost. We apply our model to urban bus fleets regulated under the California Cap-and-Trade Program. We find that a carbon price of $35 per ton of CO2e (2024 average) incentivizes firms to configure their fleets such that battery-electric drivetrains constitute 70% of usable installed capacity and 92% of annual demand, while diesel drivetrains serve peak loads. Since the resulting emissions are fairly inelastic to the carbon price, we conclude that the life-cycle cost per mile would increase substantially if deep decarbonization were to be induced entirely by higher carbon prices.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个碳减排成本模型，帮助企业以最低成本配置资产组合实现减排目标。应用于加州公交车队案例发现，35美元/吨的碳价可激励70%电池电动化，但深度脱碳需大幅提高碳价，导致每英里成本显著增加。
AI.research_question: 企业如何以最低成本配置资产组合来实现环境法规和自愿减排目标？碳价格如何影响企业的资产配置决策以实现深度脱碳？
AI.motivation: 各行业公司需要评估遵守环境法规和实现自愿减排目标的成本，但缺乏有效的决策工具来配置具有不同成本和负荷特征的资产组合以实现最低成本的减排。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳减排成本曲线理论、资产组合优化理论、碳定价机制理论、边际减排成本分析。
AI.method: 开发碳减排成本模型，构建减排成本曲线作为决策工具，应用于加州限额与交易计划下的城市公交车队案例研究。
AI.findings: 35美元/吨CO2e的碳价可激励企业配置70%电池电动驱动系统和92%的年需求由电动满足，柴油系统服务高峰负荷。排放对碳价相当不弹性，若完全依赖更高碳价实现深度脱碳，每英里生命周期成本将大幅增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了适用于多资产组合的碳减排成本模型，扩展了减排成本曲线的应用范围，为资产配置决策提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了实用的减排成本决策工具，帮助管理者优化资产配置以实现最低成本减排，为政策制定者提供了碳价影响的实际证据。

title: Looser, Tighter, Clearer: A New Financial Conditions Index for the Euro Area
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Looser, Tighter, Clearer: A New Financial Conditions Index for the Euro Area
detail.abstract: Financial Conditions Indices (FCIs) are a widely used tool for assessing the broader monetary policy stance beyond the central bank’s direct control. This paper presents a novel vector autoregressive (VAR) model that includes key macroeconomic variables and maps financial variables into a single index, named Macro-Finance FCI. The VAR coefficients and the FCI weights are estimated jointly in one step, ensuring a model-consistent microfinance feedback. The model-implied long-run mean of the index provides a neutral benchmark to which financial conditions converge when inflation is at target and output is at potential. For the euro area, the proposed FCI incorporates nine asset prices – including risk-free rates, sovereign spreads, risk assets, and the exchange rate – and assigns a dominant role to nominal interest rates. It outperforms existing indices in out-of-sample forecasts of inflation and output. A structural identification of supply, demand, and financial shocks indicates that financial conditions require up to one year to transmit to the real economy and almost up to two years to inflation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的向量自回归（VAR）模型，将关键宏观经济变量和金融变量映射为单一指数（宏观金融FCI），通过一步联合估计VAR系数和FCI权重，确保模型一致的微观金融反馈。该指数为欧元区提供了优于现有指数的通胀和产出预测能力。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够更好评估货币政策立场、包含金融变量与宏观经济变量互动关系的金融状况指数（FCI），并验证其在预测通胀和产出方面的有效性？
AI.motivation: 现有金融状况指数（FCIs）虽然被广泛用于评估货币政策立场，但通常缺乏与宏观经济变量的系统性整合，且未能提供模型一致的中性基准来衡量金融条件何时处于中性状态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于向量自回归（VAR）理论框架，将金融变量映射为单一指数，同时考虑金融变量与宏观经济变量（通胀、产出）之间的动态互动关系，建立模型一致的金融反馈机制。
AI.method: 提出新颖的VAR模型，一步联合估计VAR系数和FCI权重，确保模型一致的微观金融反馈。为欧元区构建包含9种资产价格（无风险利率、主权利差、风险资产、汇率）的宏观金融FCI，并通过结构识别分析供给、需求和金融冲击的传导机制。
AI.findings: 1）提出的FCI在通胀和产出的样本外预测中优于现有指数；2）指数隐含的长期均值提供了中性基准；3）金融条件传导到实体经济需要约1年时间，传导到通胀需要近2年时间；4）名义利率在指数中起主导作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了模型一致的金融状况指数构建方法；2）建立了金融变量与宏观经济变量联合估计的理论框架；3）提供了金融条件传导时滞的理论解释；4）发展了结构冲击识别在金融传导分析中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了更准确的金融状况评估工具；2）改进了通胀和产出的预测能力；3）提供了金融条件传导时滞的实证证据；4）为欧元区货币政策分析提供了实用工具。

title: Hub Only Pipeline Topology Architecture Standard (HOPT-AS)
affiliations: Novonanmek Material Sciences Private Limited

detail.title: Hub Only Pipeline Topology Architecture Standard (HOPT-AS)
detail.abstract:
The Hub-Only Pipeline Topology Architecture Standard (HOPT-AS) v1.0 defines a governed, system-level architecture for large-scale carbon capture, transport, and storage (CCUS) in regions where conventional emitter-to-pipeline models are economically, logistically, or regulatorily constrained. The standard formalizes the Hub-Only Pipeline Topology (HOPT), an architectural approach in which industrial emitters capture CO₂ in solid-bound form and interface exclusively through solids-based logistics, while all gaseous CO₂ handling, conditioning, compression, and pipeline injection occur at centralized regeneration hubs. CO₂ pipelines therefore connect only hubs to hubs and onward to storage or utilization, eliminating direct emitter–pipeline connectivity.

HOPT-AS establishes mandatory topology rules, system boundaries, stakeholder roles, and participation constraints to ensure interoperability, scalability, and architectural integrity across multi-stakeholder deployments. The standard defines hub and emitter classes, permitted topology families, governance and certification mechanisms, registry-based chain-of-custody, and a structured framework for monitoring, reporting, and verification (MRV). It is technology-neutral with respect to capture chemistry and detailed engineering design, focusing instead on architectural consistency, governance, and repeatable deployment models.

By relocating gaseous CO₂ handling from emitters to shared hubs, HOPT-AS lowers entry barriers for small and medium emitters, reduces total pipeline length and permitting complexity, and enables phased deployment using existing logistics infrastructure. The standard is intended for reference, design alignment, pilot deployment, early adoption, and future certification by industry, governments, regulators, financiers, and infrastructure developers seeking scalable CCUS systems in distributed industrial regions.

AI.tldr: HOPT-AS v1.0标准定义了大规模碳捕集、运输和存储的枢纽式管道拓扑架构，通过将气态CO₂处理集中在共享枢纽而非排放源，降低中小排放者参与门槛，减少管道长度和许可复杂性。
AI.research_question: 如何为经济、物流或监管受限地区的大规模CCUS系统设计可扩展、可互操作的架构标准？
AI.motivation: 传统排放源到管道的模型在经济、物流或监管方面受限，需要新的架构来降低中小排放者参与门槛，减少管道基础设施复杂性和许可难度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 枢纽式管道拓扑架构理论，系统级架构设计原则，分布式工业系统治理框架，技术中立的设计理念。
AI.method: 建立强制性拓扑规则、系统边界、利益相关者角色和参与约束，定义枢纽和排放源类别，制定治理和认证机制，基于注册的监管链系统，结构化MRV框架。
AI.findings: HOPT-AS通过集中化气态CO₂处理降低中小排放者参与门槛，减少总管道长度和许可复杂性，支持分阶段部署，实现跨多利益相关者部署的互操作性和可扩展性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了枢纽式管道拓扑架构的理论框架，建立了CCUS系统级架构标准化的新范式，发展了分布式工业系统治理的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为行业、政府、监管机构、金融机构和基础设施开发者提供可参考的设计标准，支持试点部署和早期采用，为未来认证奠定基础，促进分布式工业区域的可扩展CCUS系统建设。

title: Macroeconomic Effects Of Carbon-intensive Energy Price Changes: A Model Comparison
affiliations: Swiss National Bank, , Central Bank of Chile, , European Central Bank (ECB), Deutsche Bundesbank, , Banco de España, Deutsche Bundesbank and European Union - Directorate General for Economic and Financial Affairs (DG ECFIN)

detail.title: Macroeconomic Effects Of Carbon-intensive Energy Price Changes: A Model Comparison
detail.abstract: This paper presents a novel model comparison to examine the challenges posed by changes in carbon-intensive energy prices for monetary policy. The employed environmental monetary models have a detailed multi-sector structure. The comparison assesses the effects of both a temporary and a permanent energy price increase with a particular focus on the euro area and the United States. Temporary and permanent price shocks are both inflationary. However, the inflationary impact of the permanent shock depends on the underlying model assumptions and monetary policy response. The analysis also establishes that these models share large commonalities in their quantitative and qualitative results, while also pointing out cross-country differences.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过环境货币模型比较，分析了碳密集型能源价格变化对货币政策的挑战，重点关注欧元区和美国。研究发现临时性和永久性能源价格冲击都会导致通胀，但永久性冲击的通胀影响取决于模型假设和货币政策反应。
AI.research_question: 碳密集型能源价格变化对货币政策构成哪些挑战？临时性和永久性能源价格冲击对通胀的影响有何不同？这些影响在欧元区和美国之间有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着全球向低碳经济转型，碳密集型能源价格波动对货币政策制定者构成新挑战。理解这些价格变化对通胀和货币政策的影响对于制定有效的政策应对至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境货币模型，具有详细的多部门结构，用于分析能源价格冲击对宏观经济和货币政策的影响。
AI.method: 模型比较方法，使用具有多部门结构的环境货币模型，分析临时性和永久性能源价格冲击的影响，重点关注欧元区和美国。
AI.findings: 1. 临时性和永久性能源价格冲击都具有通胀效应；2. 永久性冲击的通胀影响取决于模型假设和货币政策反应；3. 不同模型在定量和定性结果上具有很大共性；4. 存在跨国家差异（欧元区与美国）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了环境货币模型比较框架；2. 揭示了能源价格冲击对货币政策传导机制的影响；3. 区分了临时性和永久性冲击的不同影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为货币政策制定者应对能源价格冲击提供分析工具；2. 帮助理解不同国家（欧元区vs美国）对能源价格冲击的敏感性差异；3. 为低碳转型过程中的货币政策调整提供参考。

title: Industrial Policy as Market-Shaping Competition: Evidence from China, the European Union, and the United States (2009-2024)

detail.title: Industrial Policy as Market-Shaping Competition: Evidence from China, the European Union, and the United States (2009-2024)
detail.abstract: This paper documents the evolution of contemporary industrial policy across China, the European Union, and the United States between 2009 and 2024 using an extended panel from the New Industrial Policy Observatory. Focusing on selective industrial actions that plausibly alter relative competitive conditions, the analysis characterises industrial policy as a persistent, market-shaping phenomenon rather than a temporary response to macroeconomic shocks. Ten stylised facts document a sharp and sustained expansion in industrial policy activity after 2019, a reorientation of stated policy motives toward security and resilience and increasing concentration of interventions in strategic and dual-use sectors. Industrial actions increasingly propagate across jurisdictions through rapid crosscountry sequencing. Subsidies diffuse quickly among major economies and are frequently followed by import restrictions in large domestic markets, while defensive trade measures become more rival-directed. At the same time, policy instruments diverge in persistence: export restrictions have become structurally durable, whereas import barriers remain more contingent. Taken together, the evidence points to a shift from episodic intervention toward a competitive and sequential industrial policy regime organised around strategic value chains and chokepoints, with important implications for trade governance and the multilateral trading system.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用新产业政策观察站数据，分析了2009-2024年间中国、欧盟和美国的产业政策演变，发现2019年后产业政策活动急剧扩张，政策动机转向安全和韧性，干预集中在战略和军民两用领域，呈现出竞争性和序列化的新产业政策体制。
AI.research_question: 2009-2024年间中国、欧盟和美国当代产业政策如何演变？产业政策是否从临时干预转向持久性市场塑造机制？
AI.motivation: 理解全球主要经济体产业政策的系统性变化，特别是2019年后产业政策活动的扩张和转型，以及这对国际贸易治理和多边贸易体系的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业政策理论、市场塑造理论、战略价值链理论、国际贸易理论、政策扩散理论
AI.method: 使用新产业政策观察站的扩展面板数据，分析中国、欧盟和美国2009-2024年的选择性产业行动，采用描述性统计和模式识别方法识别十个典型事实。
AI.findings: 1) 2019年后产业政策活动急剧持续扩张；2) 政策动机转向安全和韧性；3) 干预集中在战略和军民两用领域；4) 产业行动通过快速跨国序列化传播；5) 补贴在主要经济体间快速扩散；6) 补贴常被大型国内市场进口限制跟随；7) 防御性贸易措施更具针对性；8) 出口限制变得结构持久；9) 进口壁垒保持更多临时性；10) 产业政策从偶发干预转向竞争性序列化体制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将产业政策重新概念化为持久性市场塑造现象而非临时宏观经济应对；提出竞争性序列化产业政策体制理论框架；拓展战略价值链和瓶颈点理论在政策分析中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供产业政策演变趋势的实证依据；揭示国际贸易治理面临的挑战；为多边贸易体系改革提供参考；帮助企业理解政策环境变化和战略调整方向。

title: Brief of 76 Scholars of Law, Business, Economics, and Medicine as Amici Curiae in Support of Petitioners, Hikma Pharmaceuticals v. Amarin Pharma, Inc. et al.
affiliations: Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey - Rutgers Law School, American University Washington College of Law, West Virginia University - College of Law and Harvard University - Harvard Medical School

detail.title: Brief of 76 Scholars of Law, Business, Economics, and Medicine as Amici Curiae in Support of Petitioners, Hikma Pharmaceuticals v. Amarin Pharma, Inc. et al.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
For a century and a half, the doctrine of inducement of patent infringement has required an act that is specific, unambiguous, and affirmative. Conduct that (1) does not specifically encourage infringement, (2) is ambiguous as to infringing or noninfringing behavior, or (3) is an omission has long been insufficient for patent inducement liability.

In Hikma v. Amarin, the Federal Circuit disregarded these principles. The court held that inducement liability could arise based on speculative inferences from general marketing statements and mandatory drug labeling text--statements that bore no specificity to the patented methods of use at issue. That holding followed the court's 2021 decision in GlaxoSmithKline LLC v. Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, which also expanded patent inducement beyond its historic bounds.

Such expansion is not just wrong on the law--it threatens the statutory scheme for generic drug competition, the innovation economy, the patent system's foundational principles, and patient health and welfare. This brief, submitted on behalf of 76 professors of law, business, economics, and medicine, argues that the Supreme Court should return inducement law to its well-established roots.

AI.tldr: 联邦巡回法院在Hikma v. Amarin案中背离了专利引诱侵权原则的传统要求，基于一般营销声明和强制性药品标签文本的推测性推断认定引诱侵权责任，这威胁了仿制药竞争、创新经济和患者健康。
AI.research_question: 联邦巡回法院在专利引诱侵权案件中是否错误地扩大了责任范围，背离了传统法律原则？
AI.motivation: 联邦巡回法院在Hikma v. Amarin和GlaxoSmithKline v. Teva案中的判决扩大了专利引诱侵权责任，威胁了仿制药竞争法定机制、创新经济、专利制度基本原则以及患者健康与福利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利引诱侵权理论：传统上要求具体、明确、肯定的行为，不鼓励侵权的行为、模糊的行为或遗漏行为不足以构成引诱侵权责任。
AI.method: 法律分析：基于76位法学、商学、经济学和医学教授的法庭之友意见书，分析联邦巡回法院判决对传统专利引诱侵权原则的背离。
AI.findings: 联邦巡回法院的判决背离了专利引诱侵权原则的传统要求，基于一般营销声明和强制性药品标签文本的推测性推断认定责任，这与一个半世纪以来的法律原则相冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清专利引诱侵权理论的核心原则，强调具体性、明确性和肯定性要求的重要性，为最高法院恢复传统法律原则提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为最高法院提供法律依据以纠正联邦巡回法院的错误判决，保护仿制药竞争机制，维护创新经济平衡，保障患者获得可负担药品的权益。

title: Urban Infoanalytics: Bridging the Gap between City Data and Governance A Framework for Effective Decision Infrastructure

detail.title: Urban Infoanalytics: Bridging the Gap between City Data and Governance A Framework for Effective Decision Infrastructure
detail.abstract:
Cities today have never been technically 'smarter'; we have sensors, satellites, and advanced models for almost everything. Yet, the actual work of running a city often feels as slow and reactive as ever. The problem isn’t that we lack data; it’s that this data rarely connects with the people who need to make decisions in the moment.

This paper introduces Urban Infoanalytics, a methodology designed to bridge that disconnected 'last mile' between raw numbers and real institutional action. Instead of just generating more complex data, we propose flipping the workflow: starting with the decision that needs to be made and working backward. The key is embedding 'Translators', staff fluent in both policy and code, directly into municipal teams. This turns static dashboards into an active decision infrastructure. Ultimately, success isn't about the perfection of the model; it is about whether the city runs faster, responds better, and allocates resources more fairly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Urban Infoanalytics方法，通过嵌入"翻译者"角色来连接数据与决策，解决智慧城市中数据与实际行动脱节的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何解决智慧城市中数据丰富但决策行动脱节的"最后一英里"问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管城市拥有大量传感器、卫星和先进模型，但实际城市管理工作仍然缓慢被动，问题在于数据无法及时连接到需要实时决策的人员。
AI.theoretical_framework: Urban Infoanalytics方法论，强调从决策需求出发逆向工作流程，引入"翻译者"角色作为政策与代码的桥梁。
AI.method: 将精通政策和代码的"翻译者"直接嵌入市政团队，将静态仪表板转变为主动决策基础设施。
AI.findings: 成功的关键不在于模型的完美性，而在于城市是否运行更快、响应更好、资源分配更公平。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Urban Infoanalytics理论框架，重新定义了智慧城市中数据与决策的连接方式，强调从决策需求出发的逆向工作流程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市管理者提供了具体的实施方法：嵌入"翻译者"角色，建立主动决策基础设施，提高城市运行效率和资源分配公平性。

title: The Adoption of Quantum Computing Technologies
affiliations: ETH Zürich and Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management

detail.title: The Adoption of Quantum Computing Technologies
detail.abstract: Quantum computing can revolutionize search methods by boosting their cost efficiency. In this paper we analyze under which conditions companies should adopt quantum computing for search problems, by considering the core functioning of quantum search algorithms. Whereas classical search allows incremental discovery-firms learn immediately whether a candidate solution is valid-a quantum search algorithm must inspect all candidates in superposition and can reveal results only after the inspection of all elements is completed. We show that this difference in timing of information revelation fundamentally alters the competitive outcome. In monopoly settings, quantum search provides the expected cost efficiency. Under competition, however, delayed revelation eliminates the economic speedup: when the number of competitors is large, classical search dominates quantum search despite its higher computational cost when there is a premium for early discovery. Quantum adoption becomes optimal only for sufficiently complex problems where search-cost efficiency outweighs the early discovery premium. These results highlight that a quantum speedup does not automatically translate into economic advantage and provide conditions under which firms should adopt quantum search technologies.

AI.tldr: 量子计算能提升搜索效率，但在竞争环境下，量子搜索的信息延迟揭示会抵消其计算优势。只有当问题足够复杂、搜索成本效率超过早期发现溢价时，量子搜索才有经济优势。
AI.research_question: 企业在什么条件下应该采用量子计算来解决搜索问题？量子计算的速度优势是否能自动转化为经济优势？
AI.motivation: 量子计算有潜力通过提升搜索效率来革新搜索方法，但量子搜索算法与经典搜索在信息揭示时机上存在根本差异，这可能影响其在竞争环境中的经济价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于量子搜索算法（如Grover算法）的核心机制，对比经典搜索与量子搜索在信息揭示时机上的差异。经典搜索允许增量发现，而量子搜索需要检查所有候选解后才能揭示结果。
AI.method: 理论分析，通过比较经典搜索和量子搜索在不同市场结构（垄断和竞争）下的表现，考虑搜索成本效率和早期发现溢价之间的权衡。
AI.findings: 1. 在垄断环境下，量子搜索提供预期的成本效率优势；2. 在竞争环境下，信息延迟揭示会消除经济加速：当竞争者数量较多时，尽管量子搜索计算成本更低，但经典搜索仍占优势（因为有早期发现溢价）；3. 只有当问题足够复杂、搜索成本效率超过早期发现溢价时，量子搜索才成为最优选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了量子计算的速度优势不一定能转化为经济优势，提出了量子搜索在竞争环境中的采用条件理论框架，强调了信息揭示时机对技术采用决策的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了量子搜索技术采用的决策框架：需要考虑问题复杂度、竞争环境、早期发现溢价等因素，而不是单纯追求计算速度优势。

title: Intelligence as Trajectory-Dominant Pareto Optimization
affiliations: Clevix AI Research and Clevix LLC

detail.title: Intelligence as Trajectory-Dominant Pareto Optimization
detail.abstract: Recent advances in artificial intelligence have produced systems with impressive task-level performance, yet many display an early saturation in long-horizon adaptability despite continued optimization. Standard evaluation paradigms-centered on point-wise performance, terminal outcomes, or static multi-objective trade-offs-struggle to explain why systems that remain locally optimal nevertheless become developmentally constrained over time. In this work, we argue that this limitation arises from a deeper mischaracterization of intelligence itself. We propose a foundational reformulation in which intelligence is understood as a property of agent trajectories rather than isolated states. Within this view, we introduce trajectorydominant Pareto optimization, a path-wise generalization of classical Pareto optimality where dominance relations are defined over accumulated multi-objective costs along entire trajectories. This formulation reveals the existence of Pareto traps: regions of trajectory space that are locally nondominated yet globally restrictive, preventing access to alternative developmental paths without temporary degradation. To clarify the structure of these constraints, we develop a mathematical taxonomy of Pareto traps based on their geometric signatures, and introduce the Trap Escape Difficulty Index (TEDI), an intrinsic measure of how difficult it is for an agent to escape a given trap. Dynamic intelligence ceilings emerge naturally as geometric consequences of trajectory-level dominance, with TEDI providing a principled way to compare the rigidity of such ceilings across systems and optimization regimes. We illustrate these ideas using a minimal model contrasting point-wise and trajectory-dominant agents, showing how ceiling formation and escape arise independently of architectural limits or computational scale. By shifting attention from local performance to trajectory accessibility, this framework offers a structural explanation for longhorizon stagnation and establishes a foundation for studying adaptive restructuring, developmental phase transitions, and commitment-aware intelligent systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出轨迹主导的帕累托优化框架，将智能视为代理轨迹而非孤立状态的属性，揭示帕累托陷阱的存在及其对长期适应性的限制，并引入陷阱逃逸难度指数来量化这种限制。
AI.research_question: 为什么人工智能系统在任务级性能表现优异的情况下，长期适应性会出现早期饱和？如何从结构上解释这种长期停滞现象？
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统在持续优化下仍出现长期适应性早期饱和，标准评估范式（基于点状性能、终端结果或静态多目标权衡）无法解释为何局部最优的系统会随时间发展受限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 智能作为代理轨迹属性的基础重构；2. 轨迹主导的帕累托优化（经典帕累托最优性的路径泛化）；3. 帕累托陷阱理论；4. 陷阱逃逸难度指数（TEDI）；5. 动态智能天花板作为轨迹级支配的几何结果。
AI.method: 1. 提出轨迹主导的帕累托优化数学框架；2. 基于几何特征建立帕累托陷阱的数学分类学；3. 引入陷阱逃逸难度指数（TEDI）作为内在度量；4. 使用点状代理与轨迹主导代理对比的最小模型进行概念验证。
AI.findings: 1. 存在帕累托陷阱：轨迹空间中局部非支配但全局限制的区域，阻止访问替代发展路径而不经历暂时性能退化；2. 动态智能天花板是轨迹级支配的自然几何结果；3. TEDI提供比较不同系统和优化机制下天花板刚度的原则性方法；4. 天花板形成和逃逸独立于架构限制或计算规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将智能重新定义为代理轨迹属性而非孤立状态；2. 建立轨迹主导的帕累托优化理论框架；3. 提出帕累托陷阱概念及其数学分类学；4. 引入陷阱逃逸难度指数（TEDI）；5. 为长期停滞提供结构性解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为研究自适应重构、发展相变和承诺感知智能系统奠定基础；2. 提供评估系统长期适应性的新框架；3. 帮助设计能够避免帕累托陷阱的智能系统；4. 为比较不同系统和优化机制提供量化工具。

title: NEXAT: A System-Based Approach to Integrated and Soil-Conserving Crop Production

detail.title: NEXAT: A System-Based Approach to Integrated and Soil-Conserving Crop Production

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests or financial relationships that could have influenced the outcomes of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it does not involve human or animal subjects. All data were obtained from publicly available sources or manufacturer documentation.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted without external funding.

detail.abstract: Agricultural mechanization over the past century has largely evolved through incremental optimization of specialized machines, resulting in fragmented field operations, high energy consumption, repeated soil compaction, and increasing capital intensity. NEXAT (Next Generation Agriculture Technology) represents a fundamentally different approach by rethinking crop production as a unified technical system rather than a collection of independent machines. Developed by NEXAT GmbH in Germany, the NEXAT concept integrates all major arable farming operations including tillage, seeding, fertilization, crop protection, and harvesting into a single modular carrier platform operating under a wide-span controlled traffic farming framework. This paper presents a system-level analysis of the NEXAT concept, focusing on its technical architecture, operational principles, agronomic rationale, economic positioning, and sustainability claims. The study critically evaluates the potential of NEXAT to reduce soil compaction, improve operational efficiency, and enable regenerative farming practices, while also identifying structural limitations, adoption barriers, and research gaps.

AI.tldr: NEXAT系统通过模块化平台整合所有主要耕作操作，采用宽跨距控制交通农业框架，旨在减少土壤压实、提高效率并支持再生农业实践。
AI.research_question: NEXAT概念作为统一的农业技术系统，相比传统专业化机械，能否有效减少土壤压实、提高运营效率并支持再生农业实践？
AI.motivation: 传统农业机械化通过专业化机械的渐进优化，导致田间操作碎片化、能耗高、土壤反复压实和资本密集度增加，需要从根本上重新思考作物生产系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统思维、统一技术系统理论、宽跨距控制交通农业框架、模块化平台设计、再生农业原则。
AI.method: 系统级分析，包括技术架构、操作原理、农学原理、经济定位和可持续性声明的批判性评估。
AI.findings: NEXAT概念在减少土壤压实、提高运营效率和实现再生农业实践方面具有潜力，但也存在结构限制、采用障碍和研究空白。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将作物生产视为统一技术系统而非独立机械集合的新范式，为农业机械化提供了系统级理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业实践提供了减少土壤压实、提高效率的可行技术方案，为再生农业转型提供了技术基础，并识别了实际应用中的挑战和障碍。

title: A Field Experiment on the Effectiveness of Framing Climate Action: Direct vs. Indirect Effects
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, ESSEC Business School, Geneva Finance Research Institute, University of Alberta and York University - Schulich School of Business

detail.title: A Field Experiment on the Effectiveness of Framing Climate Action: Direct vs. Indirect Effects

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study protocol was approved by the research ethics committee of Montpellier Business School.

detail.abstract:
Climate action remains insufficient to meet Paris Agreement targets, creating an urgent need to understand how to effectively motivate individual pro-environmental behavior. While traditional approaches emphasize the direct impact of individual behavioral changes, we investigate whether highlighting the indirect effects of social contagion—where one's behavior influences others—can more effectively drive climate action.

Through a field experiment with 579 business school students participating in Climate Collage workshops, we compare two message framings: a "direct effect" approach emphasizing personal carbon footprint reduction, and an "indirect effect" approach emphasizing how visible behavior changes can influence others and create new social norms. We measure both pro-environmental behaviors (PEBs) and behavioral visibility (sharing behaviors on social media and with others).

Our findings reveal that while both framings equally increase PEBs, the indirect framing significantly increases participants' sharing of environmental behaviors on social media three weeks post-intervention. Importantly, this effect is moderated by individual psychological traits: the indirect framing is most effective for individuals high in negative environmental outcome affect and low in resistance to coercion. Post-hoc analysis shows that indirect framing better alleviates negative emotions elicited by climate education.

These findings contribute to institutional theory's microfoundations by demonstrating that awareness of one's role as an influencer can motivate behavior change, though message tailoring based on individual traits is critical. Our results offer practical insights for designing high-impact climate education interventions that leverage social contagion effects.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实地实验比较了两种气候行动信息框架：强调个人碳足迹减少的"直接效应"框架 vs 强调行为可见性及社会传染的"间接效应"框架。研究发现两种框架都能增加亲环境行为，但间接框架更能促进参与者在社交媒体上分享环保行为，且效果受个体心理特质调节。
AI.research_question: 强调社会传染间接效应（个人行为如何影响他人并创造新社会规范）的信息框架是否比强调直接个人影响的信息框架更能有效激励个体的亲环境行为？
AI.motivation: 当前气候行动仍不足以实现《巴黎协定》目标，迫切需要了解如何有效激励个体亲环境行为。传统方法强调个体行为改变的直接影响，但需要探索强调社会传染间接效应是否更有效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论的微观基础、社会传染理论、行为可见性理论、信息框架效应、个体心理特质（负面环境结果情感、对强制的抵抗）的调节作用。
AI.method: 采用579名商学院学生参与气候拼图工作坊的实地实验，随机分配两种信息框架：直接效应框架（强调个人碳足迹减少）vs 间接效应框架（强调可见行为改变如何影响他人并创造新社会规范）。测量亲环境行为和行为的可见性（社交媒体分享和与他人分享）。
AI.findings: 1. 两种框架都能同等增加亲环境行为；2. 间接框架显著增加了干预后三周参与者在社交媒体上分享环境行为；3. 间接框架的效果受个体心理特质调节：对负面环境结果情感高且对强制抵抗低的个体效果最好；4. 事后分析显示间接框架能更好地缓解气候教育引发的负面情绪。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为制度理论的微观基础做出贡献，证明个体意识到自己作为影响者的角色可以激励行为改变；2. 强调信息定制基于个体特质的重要性；3. 深化了对社会传染机制在环境行为中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为设计高影响力的气候教育干预提供实用见解；2. 展示了如何利用社会传染效应；3. 提供了针对不同心理特质个体的信息框架策略；4. 帮助缓解气候教育可能引发的负面情绪。

title: Tariff Changes in the U.S. from 1840-2024: A Narrative Analysis
affiliations: Northwestern University and

detail.title: Tariff Changes in the U.S. from 1840-2024: A Narrative Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper contains a detailed narrative analysis of legislative tariff changes in the United States from 1840-2024. The primary aim of this account is to provide the basis for the classification of tariff changes used in den Besten and Känzig (2025), which in turn allows for the identification of the causal effects of tariff policy on the economy. We systematically identify major tariff policy changes, place each reform in its economic and political context, and assess the stated motivations based on contemporary narrative sources. In this way, we distinguish between tariff changes driven by plausibly exogenous considerations and those responding to prevailing economic conditions. Our narrative analysis identifies 35 major tariff reforms between 1840 and the present. Of these, we classify 21 tariff changes as exogenous and 14 as endogenous. We also hope the narrative account, historiographical research and data contained in this paper is interesting in its own right. To our knowledge, no existing study provides a systematic analysis of the motives behind U.S. tariff policy over such a long historical horizon, spanning from the mid-19th century to the modern era.

AI.tldr: 本文对美国1840-2024年间的关税立法变化进行了详细的叙事分析，为den Besten和Känzig(2025)的分类提供基础，从而识别关税政策对经济的因果效应。研究识别了35次主要关税改革，其中21次为外生性变化，14次为内生性变化。
AI.research_question: 如何系统识别和分类美国1840-2024年间的关税政策变化，区分外生性和内生性关税改革？
AI.motivation: 为den Besten和Känzig(2025)的研究提供关税变化分类基础，从而能够识别关税政策对经济的因果效应。目前缺乏对美国关税政策动机进行如此长期历史跨度（19世纪中期到现代）的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税政策分析框架，区分外生性（由外部政治、战略等非经济因素驱动）和内生性（由当前经济条件驱动）关税变化，为因果识别提供理论基础。
AI.method: 叙事分析方法：系统识别主要关税政策变化，将每次改革置于其经济和政治背景中，基于当代叙事来源评估陈述动机，从而区分外生性和内生性关税变化。
AI.findings: 识别出1840年至今的35次主要关税改革，其中21次被分类为外生性关税变化，14次为内生性关税变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供了长期历史跨度的关税政策动机系统分析框架；2) 建立了区分外生性和内生性关税变化的分类标准；3) 为关税政策的因果效应研究提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为后续研究（den Besten和Känzig, 2025）提供了关税变化分类数据；2) 提供了1840-2024年美国关税政策的历史叙述和史料研究；3) 为政策制定者理解关税改革的驱动因素提供了历史视角。

title: Education - The Key to the Success of the New Zimbabwean Currency (ZWG)
affiliations: Mirracle Consultants

detail.title: Education - The Key to the Success of the New Zimbabwean Currency (ZWG)
detail.abstract: Money has been evolving since the advent of civilisation, with people exchanging goods (barter trade) in the early years. Later, precious stones were used to pay for goods and services, and in recent years, the use of crypto assets has been on the rise. In 2021, El Salvador became the first country to adopt Bitcoin as a legal tender, and the government has recently identified the need to provide Bitcoin education to the citizens. Recently, the Zimbabwean government introduced a structured currency in an attempt to stabilise the economy through the curbing of excessive inflation, among other measures. Similar to El Salvador's investment in Bitcoin education, it is critical for the Zimbabwean government to invest in the education of its citizens regarding the new structured currency. Thus, the aim of this paper is to raise the awareness of Zimbabwean citizens, by critically interrogating the viability of the new structured currency. To achieve the above, an exploratory study, in form of literature review was used. From the results obtained, it was found that the value of the Zimbabwean structured currency is influenced by the following factors; gold reserves, gold prices, economic indicators, government policies, market demand of the currency, global events, trust and confidence, political differences, multi-currency system, informal sector activities, availability of foreign currency, speculation and market sentiment, and exchange rates. Furthermore, these factors were divided into three categories namely; primary factors, secondary factors, and tertiary factors. In conclusion, it was determined that the new Zimbabwean structured currency is a viable enabler to Zimbabwe's 2030 development goals.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献综述探讨了津巴布韦新结构化货币的可行性，识别了影响其价值的13个因素并将其分为三类，最终认为该货币有助于实现津巴布韦2030年发展目标。
AI.research_question: 津巴布韦新结构化货币的可行性如何？
AI.motivation: 借鉴萨尔瓦多投资比特币教育的经验，津巴布韦政府需要教育公民了解新结构化货币，同时该货币旨在通过遏制过度通胀等措施稳定经济。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币演化理论、结构化货币理论、经济发展理论
AI.method: 探索性研究，采用文献综述方法
AI.findings: 识别了影响津巴布韦结构化货币价值的13个因素：黄金储备、黄金价格、经济指标、政府政策、货币市场需求、全球事件、信任与信心、政治分歧、多货币体系、非正规部门活动、外汇可得性、投机与市场情绪、汇率。这些因素被分为三类：主要因素、次要因素和三级因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了影响结构化货币价值的三层次因素框架，为发展中国家货币改革提供了理论分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为津巴布韦政府实施货币教育和政策制定提供依据，帮助公民理解新货币的运作机制，支持2030年发展目标的实现。

title: Russia's Money Cliff: Paying for War After Petrodollars Vanish
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Russia's Money Cliff: Paying for War After Petrodollars Vanish
detail.abstract: Russia's war in Ukraine isn't just a military problem-it's also becoming a liquidity problem. Moscow burns roughly $200 million a day. When oil buyers pay less or fewer barrels flow due to attacks and ship seizures, the Kremlin will have to start selling the country itself. Russia holds about $350 billion of gold, its most truly liquid asset. In its National Wealth Fund, Moscow holds approximately $100 billion worth of Chinese RMB, Sberbank shares, and other "accessible" foreign exchange. In a crisis, these assets wouldn't fetch full value. The RMB isn't freely convertible and Sberbank shares are illiquid. A $50B recovery value is probably generous. Each billion USD could realistically fund 3-to-4 days of warfare at today's intensity.

AI.tldr: 俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争不仅是军事问题，也正在演变为流动性问题。莫斯科每天消耗约2亿美元，当石油收入减少时，俄罗斯将被迫出售国家资产。俄罗斯持有约3500亿美元黄金和1000亿美元"可动用"外汇储备，但在危机中这些资产的实际价值会大打折扣。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯在乌克兰战争中的财政可持续性如何？当石油收入减少时，俄罗斯的流动性资产能否支持持续的军事行动？
AI.motivation: 分析俄罗斯战争融资的脆弱性，评估其流动性资产在石油收入下降时的实际价值，为理解战争的经济可持续性提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性理论、资产估值理论、战争融资经济学、外汇储备管理理论
AI.method: 基于公开数据的定量分析，包括：1) 俄罗斯每日战争成本估算；2) 流动性资产估值（黄金、外汇储备）；3) 资产变现能力分析；4) 战争可持续性计算
AI.findings: 1) 俄罗斯每日战争成本约2亿美元；2) 3500亿美元黄金是最具流动性的资产；3) 1000亿美元"可动用"外汇储备（人民币、储蓄银行股票等）实际价值可能只有500亿美元；4) 每10亿美元只能支持3-4天的战争；5) 人民币不可自由兑换，储蓄银行股票流动性差
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了战争融资的流动性约束框架；2) 发展了危机时期资产实际价值的评估方法；3) 丰富了外汇储备流动性管理理论在冲突环境下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供俄罗斯战争可持续性的评估工具；2) 帮助投资者理解俄罗斯资产的真实风险；3) 为制裁效果评估提供量化依据；4) 为军事战略制定提供经济维度分析

title: On the Asymmetry Between Conflict and Development: Evidence from Sustainable Development Goals
affiliations: Center for Natural Resource Studies (CNRS) and Washington University in St. Louis

detail.title: On the Asymmetry Between Conflict and Development: Evidence from Sustainable Development Goals
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between (internal) armed conflict and sustainable development. Using annual panel data on 192 countries from 2000 to 2024, we employ a variety of econometric techniques to trace the impulse responses between conflict fatalities and Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) performance in both directions. Results reveal a striking asymmetry: conflict shocks produce long-lasting adverse effects on SDG performance, while SDG performance shocks exert only transient effects on conflict intensity. This asymmetry persists across external and major conflict episodes, and is robust to alternative identification strategies. Our findings indicate that sustainable development is fundamentally contingent on prior achievement of peace.

AI.tldr: 研究发现武装冲突与可持续发展之间存在不对称关系：冲突对可持续发展目标（SDG）表现产生长期负面影响，而SDG表现对冲突强度仅有短暂影响，表明和平是实现可持续发展的先决条件。
AI.research_question: 内部武装冲突与可持续发展之间是否存在双向因果关系？这种关系的强度和持久性如何？
AI.motivation: 理解冲突与发展之间的动态关系对于制定有效的发展政策和冲突预防策略至关重要，但现有研究对两者双向因果关系的持久性差异关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于冲突经济学和发展经济学理论，探讨冲突与发展之间的双向因果关系，特别关注冲击响应的不对称性和持久性。
AI.method: 使用2000-2024年192个国家的年度面板数据，采用多种计量经济学技术（包括脉冲响应分析）来追踪冲突死亡人数与SDG表现之间的双向因果关系。
AI.findings: 发现显著的不对称性：冲突冲击对SDG表现产生长期负面影响，而SDG表现冲击仅对冲突强度产生短暂影响。这种不对称性在不同类型冲突和不同识别策略下均稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论上揭示了冲突与发展关系的非对称动态特性，挑战了简单的双向因果关系假设，强调了和平作为可持续发展前提条件的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据：优先实现和平是促进可持续发展的关键，冲突预防比发展援助对长期发展更为重要。

title: Cultural Adaptation and the Uneven Emergence of Large-Scale Cooperation
affiliations: Brown University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Cultural Adaptation and the Uneven Emergence of Large-Scale Cooperation
detail.abstract: This essay suggests that the evolution of human cooperation over the course of human history should be viewed as a two-layer process. A foundational layer, rooted in subsistence and ecological pressures, shaped cooperative dispositions unevenly, whereas an expansionary layer, rooted in conflict and stratification, generated large-scale cooperation in societies in which its seeds were formed. The first evolutionary layer unfolded over the grand arc of human evolution, reinforcing the capacity for small-scale cooperation in hunter-gatherer societies while favoring traits complementary to cooperation only in some sedentary societies. The second evolutionary layer emerged as rising population density heightened external threats, fostered coercive centralized authority, and raised the returns to public infrastructure. In environments where cooperative traits had already evolved, warfare, extraction, and infrastructure provision reinforced these predispositions, transforming them into durable collective institutions. Yet in settings where such cultural foundations were absent, large-scale collective action was more challenging, and conflict was often destabilizing, magnifying division and political fragility. Recognizing the profound global heterogeneity in this foundational layer of cooperative behavior is essential for identifying the origins of large-scale cooperation and the conditions under which conflict reinforced cooperative capacity rather than intensifying fragmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出人类合作演化是一个双层过程：基础层源于生存和生态压力，塑造了不均衡的合作倾向；扩张层源于冲突和阶层分化，在已有合作基础的社会中催生了大规模合作。
AI.research_question: 人类合作在历史进程中是如何演化的？为什么不同社会在大规模合作能力上存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 解释全球范围内大规模合作能力的异质性，理解冲突在不同社会中对合作能力产生的不同影响（强化合作 vs 加剧分裂）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双层演化理论：基础层演化（生存生态压力）和扩张层演化（冲突阶层分化）；文化演化理论；制度演化理论。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念框架构建，基于历史比较和演化理论进行论证。
AI.findings: 1. 基础层演化在狩猎采集社会强化了小规模合作能力，但在定居社会中只部分促进了互补性合作特质；2. 扩张层演化通过人口密度增加、外部威胁、强制集权等机制，在已有合作基础的社会中强化了合作倾向并转化为制度；3. 缺乏合作文化基础的社会中，冲突往往加剧分裂而非促进合作。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了人类合作演化的双层理论框架，解释了合作能力的全球异质性，阐明了冲突对合作能力的条件性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解不同社会发展路径提供了理论工具，对国际合作、发展援助和冲突管理具有启示意义。

title: Industrial Policy in the Global Semiconductor Sector
affiliations: Yale University - Department of Economics, University of British Columbia (UBC), affiliation not provided to SSRN, , and

detail.title: Industrial Policy in the Global Semiconductor Sector
detail.abstract: The resurgence of subsidies and industrial policies has raised concerns about their potential inefficiency and alignment with multilateral principles. Critics warn that such policies may divert resources to less efficient firms and provoke retaliatory measures from other countries, leading to a wasteful “subsidy race.” However, subsidies for sectors with inherent cross-border externalities can have positive global effects. This paper examines these issues within the semiconductor industry: a key driver of economic growth and innovation with potentially significant learning-by-doing and strategic importance due to its dual-use applications. Our study aims to: (1) document and quantify recent industrial policies in the global semiconductor sector, (2) explore the rationale behind these policies, and (3) evaluate their economic impacts, particularly their cross-border effects, and compatibility with multilateral principles. We employ historical analysis, natural language processing, and a model-based approach to measure government support and its impacts. Our findings indicate that government support has been vital for the industry’s growth, with subsidies being the primary form of support. They also highlight the importance of cross-border technology transfers through FDI, business and research collaborations, and technology licensing. China, despite significant subsidies, does not stand out as an outlier compared to other countries, given its market size. Model estimates suggest the presence of learning-by-doing at the firm-product level as well as economies of scope within a firm and substantial cross-border learning spillovers. These spillovers likely reflect cross-country technology transfers and the role of fabless clients and input suppliers in disseminating knowledge globally through their interactions with foundries. Such cross-border spillovers are not merely accidental but result from deliberate actions by market participants that cannot be taken for granted. Firms may choose to share knowledge across borders or restrict access to frontier technology, thereby excluding certain countries. Future research will use model estimates to simulate the quantitative implications of subsidies and to explore the dynamics of a “subsidy race” in the semiconductor industry.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了半导体产业补贴政策的经济影响，发现政府支持对行业发展至关重要，补贴是主要形式。研究显示存在显著的学习效应和跨国技术溢出，中国补贴水平与其市场规模相符。未来将模拟补贴竞赛的动态影响。
AI.research_question: 半导体产业的补贴政策如何影响行业发展？这些政策的经济效应、跨国溢出效应以及与多边原则的兼容性如何？
AI.motivation: 补贴和产业政策的复兴引发了对效率和多边原则的担忧，但具有跨境外部性的行业补贴可能产生积极全球效应。半导体产业作为经济增长和创新关键驱动力，具有显著的学习效应和战略重要性，是研究这些问题的理想案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学习效应理论（learning-by-doing）、范围经济理论、技术溢出理论、跨境外部性理论、产业政策理论
AI.method: 历史分析、自然语言处理、模型驱动方法，用于衡量政府支持及其影响
AI.findings:
1. 政府支持对半导体产业增长至关重要，补贴是主要形式
2. 存在显著的企业-产品层面学习效应和企业内部范围经济
3. 存在大量跨国学习溢出，反映跨境技术转移
4. 中国补贴水平与其市场规模相符，并非异常值
5. 跨国溢出不是偶然的，而是市场参与者有意行为的结果
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为学习效应和范围经济在半导体产业中的存在提供实证证据
2. 揭示跨国技术溢出的机制和驱动因素
3. 拓展产业政策理论在具有跨境外部性行业的应用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供半导体产业补贴效果评估框架
2. 帮助理解补贴竞赛的潜在后果
3. 为多边贸易规则制定提供实证依据
4. 指导企业跨国技术转移策略

title: The Invisible Firm
affiliations: Indiana University Maurer School of Law and Indiana University Maurer School of Law

detail.title: The Invisible Firm

publicationDetails.detailsText: Indiana Legal Studies Research Paper No. 571
publicationDetails.journalName: Indiana University Maurer School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Family offices are the most powerful institutions you have never heard of. They are largely unknown for three reasons. First, they defy easy characterization. Second, they occupy a rare space that is only available to ultrahigh-net-worth individuals. And third, quietly managing trillions in private wealth, these entities operate beyond the reach of most financial regulation. Yet, they have a hand in reshaping the architecture of global capital. 

This Article offers the first comprehensive legal and economic account of the emergence of the modern family office. Drawing on foundational work in transaction cost economics, agency theory, and public choice, it explains how family offices minimize costs, preserve privacy, and exploit regulatory carveouts like the Family Office Rule. In doing so, this Article demonstrates that family offices represent a rational, equilibrium response to legal incentives--what Ronald Coase might call the "firm made private." In this way, family offices produce efficiencies and yield positive externalities that make them valuable not only to their principals but to society. 

Yet, as family offices proliferate, critics warn that their opacity, wealth-concentrating power, and potential for abuse pose growing systemic risks. This Article critically evaluates these concerns, assessing whether family offices are engines of inequality, vectors of financial instability, or surprisingly efficient vehicles for private ordering. We find greater support for the argument that family offices are exceptional private-ordering, if wealth-maximizing, vehicles that produce more benefit than harm.

AI.tldr: 本文首次全面分析了现代家族办公室的法律与经济成因，运用交易成本经济学、代理理论和公共选择理论，解释家族办公室如何降低成本、保护隐私并利用监管豁免。研究发现家族办公室是对法律激励的理性均衡反应，产生效率并带来正外部性，虽然存在批评但其作为私人秩序工具利大于弊。
AI.research_question: 现代家族办公室如何从法律与经济角度解释其出现？它们是否代表对法律激励的理性均衡反应？家族办公室是加剧不平等的引擎、金融不稳定的载体，还是高效的私人秩序工具？
AI.motivation: 家族办公室是管理数万亿私人财富的强大机构，但因其难以归类、仅面向超高净值个人、且大多不受金融监管而鲜为人知。它们在重塑全球资本架构中扮演重要角色，需要从法律和经济角度进行系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本经济学、代理理论、公共选择理论，以及罗纳德·科斯的"企业私有化"概念。
AI.method: 法律与经济学分析，结合理论框架对家族办公室现象进行系统性解释。
AI.findings: 家族办公室通过最小化成本、保护隐私和利用监管豁免（如家族办公室规则）来应对法律激励，代表一种理性均衡反应。它们产生效率并带来正外部性，虽然存在不透明、财富集中和潜在滥用风险，但作为私人秩序工具总体上利大于弊。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供现代家族办公室的全面法律与经济解释；将家族办公室概念化为"私有化的企业"；运用交易成本经济学、代理理论和公共选择理论解释其存在合理性；为私人秩序理论提供实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解家族办公室的运作逻辑；为监管者提供分析框架；为超高净值家庭提供决策参考；促进对私人财富管理机构的理性讨论。

title: Sports Betting Across Borders: Spatial Spillovers, Credit Distress, and Fiscal Externalities
affiliations: and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: Sports Betting Across Borders: Spatial Spillovers, Credit Distress, and Fiscal Externalities

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1184
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Since the 2018 Murphy v. NCAA decision, 38 states have legalized mobile sports betting. We study effects on betting and consumer credit, emphasizing spatial spillovers across state lines. Using consumer spending data and an extended two-way fixed effects framework that separately identifies direct and spillover effects, we find that legalization increases total sportsbook spending roughly tenfold and take-up by 3.1 percentage points. Counties in non-legal states within 15 miles of a legal state experience spillover spending equal to roughly 14 percent of the direct effect, with these spillovers declining to roughly zero by 60 miles. Using the New York Fed Consumer Credit Panel, we find that median credit scores decline by roughly 1 point and overall delinquency rises 0.3 percentage points from a 10.7 percent base, with spillover delinquency rising nearly 0.2 percentage points. Under-40 auto loan delinquency increases by half a percentage point and credit card delinquency by one percentage point, driving the overall increase in delinquency. Scaling the population-level delinquency effect by take-up yields implied delinquency increases of roughly 10 percentage points among induced bettors. We conclude with a policy simulation which reveals that spillovers create a fiscal asymmetry: states that have not legalized bear costs from cross-border betting without capturing tax revenue, giving high exposure states a stronger case for legalization. This incentive is increasing in states that have higher pre-legalization betting activity, population centers near legal states, and a younger population. Methodologically, we show that ignoring spatial spillovers can contribute to attenuated estimates and an under-count of the affected population.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国各州体育博彩合法化对博彩消费和消费者信用的影响，特别关注跨州界的空间溢出效应。研究发现合法化使体育博彩支出增长约10倍，参与率提高3.1个百分点，同时导致信用评分下降和违约率上升。研究还揭示了溢出效应造成的财政不对称问题。
AI.research_question: 体育博彩合法化如何影响博彩消费和消费者信用？跨州界的空间溢出效应有多大？这些溢出效应如何影响不同州的政策激励？
AI.motivation: 自2018年Murphy v. NCAA判决以来，美国已有38个州将移动体育博彩合法化。然而，现有研究缺乏对跨州界空间溢出效应的系统分析，特别是这些溢出如何影响消费者信用和不同州的财政激励。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间经济学理论、消费者行为理论、财政联邦主义理论。研究特别关注地理邻近性如何影响经济活动的空间分布和政策外部性。
AI.method: 使用消费者支出数据和纽约联储消费者信用面板数据，采用扩展的双向固定效应框架，分别识别直接效应和溢出效应。通过地理距离阈值分析空间溢出效应的衰减模式。
AI.findings: 1. 合法化使体育博彩总支出增长约10倍，参与率提高3.1个百分点；2. 非合法化州距离合法化州15英里内的县，溢出支出约为直接效应的14%，60英里外溢出效应基本为零；3. 中位数信用评分下降约1点，整体违约率从10.7%上升0.3个百分点；4. 40岁以下人群汽车贷款违约率上升0.5个百分点，信用卡违约率上升1个百分点；5. 按参与率调整后，诱导参与者的违约率上升约10个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了空间溢出效应的测量框架；2. 揭示了地理邻近性在政策外部性中的重要作用；3. 为财政联邦主义理论提供了实证支持，展示了跨辖区政策协调的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了空间溢出效应的量化证据；2. 揭示了财政不对称问题：非合法化州承担了跨境博彩的成本却无法获得税收收入；3. 识别了高暴露州（合法化前博彩活动多、靠近合法化州、年轻人口多）更强的合法化激励；4. 方法上表明忽略空间溢出会导致估计偏误和受影响人口低估。

title: Clauses To Look Out For: A Legal Guide For Foundries
affiliations: Advocate, Kolkata, India

detail.title: Clauses To Look Out For: A Legal Guide For Foundries
detail.abstract:
Foundries operate in a high-risk commercial environment where contract terms often determine profitability more than manufacturing efficiency. In the last few years, Indian foundries have become increasingly integrated into global supply chains. However, the global economy has grown more volatile due to geopolitical tensions, evolving trade policy, and supply chain disruptions. In this environment, contracts are not merely legal documents they are risk allocation tools, which should consider the following: a) high level of competition and rapid technological change; b) changes in anticipated government incentives; c) disruptions, delays, trade tensions, or shortages; d) evolving regulatory and legal requirements across many jurisdictions; e) geopolitical and international trade conditions; f) impacts of the COVID-19 or similar such pandemic; and g) other risks and uncertainties. 

Foundry businesses must now contend with a parallel external development: renewed uncertainty in global trade relationships, including recent tariff-related friction between India and the United States. For export-oriented engineering suppliers, this adds a layer of commercial unpredictability that cannot be addressed through policy announcements alone. 

In this context, the foundry sector's resilience in 2026 will depend not only on production capability, but also on contract strength and risk allocation discipline. This article highlights the key clauses foundries must negotiate or look out for and provides a contract playbook tailored for foundry management teams.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了印度铸造厂在全球供应链整合背景下，面对地缘政治紧张、贸易政策变化和供应链中断等多重风险时，如何通过合同条款作为风险分配工具来增强业务韧性。文章为铸造企业管理团队提供了专门的合同谈判指南。
AI.research_question: 在全球经济波动和地缘政治不确定性加剧的背景下，印度铸造厂如何通过合同条款设计和风险分配来增强业务韧性和盈利能力？
AI.motivation: 铸造行业处于高风险商业环境中，合同条款对盈利能力的影响往往超过制造效率。近年来印度铸造厂日益融入全球供应链，但全球经济因地缘政治紧张、贸易政策变化和供应链中断而变得更加波动。此外，印度与美国之间的关税摩擦等贸易关系不确定性增加了商业不可预测性。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 合同作为风险分配工具的理论
2. 供应链风险管理理论
3. 全球贸易不确定性下的企业韧性理论
4. 法律与商业战略交叉领域的合同设计理论
AI.method: 该论文采用规范性分析方法，基于行业实践和法律框架，识别关键合同条款，为铸造企业管理团队提供合同谈判指南和"合同剧本"。
AI.findings:
1. 铸造厂2026年的韧性不仅取决于生产能力，还取决于合同强度和风险分配纪律
2. 合同必须考虑七大风险领域：竞争与技术变化、政府激励变化、中断与延迟、监管要求、地缘政治条件、疫情影响等
3. 政策公告不足以应对贸易关系不确定性，需要具体的合同条款设计
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将合同理论扩展到高风险制造业的全球供应链环境
2. 提出了在多重不确定性下合同作为风险分配工具的分析框架
3. 丰富了企业韧性理论中合同设计维度的研究
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为铸造企业管理团队提供了专门的"合同剧本"
2. 识别了铸造厂必须谈判或关注的关键合同条款
3. 提供了在不确定贸易环境中增强业务韧性的具体合同策略

title: Open-Ended Treasury Purchases: From Market Functioning to Financial Easing
affiliations: , , Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas and Northwestern University

detail.title: Open-Ended Treasury Purchases: From Market Functioning to Financial Easing

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1183
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We assess whether the Fed's asset purchases can be tailored to either restore market functioning or provide economic stimulus. When the communicated goal is restoring market functioning and purchases' implementation is flexible, flow effects are significant: relative price deviations narrow. However, stock effects remain near zero and hence not stimulative. When the communicated goal links purchases to the achievement of the dual mandate, improving their size's predictability, stock effects rise consistently above zero. When the communicated implementation improves the predictability of the purchases' maturity composition, stock effects become large. Jointly, the communicated goal and implementation can shape the purchases' effects.

AI.tldr: 美联储资产购买的效果取决于沟通策略：当目标是恢复市场功能时，流动性效应显著但无刺激作用；当明确与双重使命挂钩时，存量效应显著且具有刺激作用；购买期限构成的透明度能增强刺激效果。
AI.research_question: 美联储的资产购买政策能否根据沟通目标（恢复市场功能vs经济刺激）和实施方式的不同，产生差异化的市场效果？
AI.motivation: 理解央行资产购买政策的效果如何受到政策沟通和实施方式的影响，为央行设计更有效的量化宽松政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 央行沟通理论、量化宽松传导机制、信号渠道与投资组合再平衡渠道、市场预期管理
AI.method: 实证分析美联储资产购买政策，区分不同沟通目标（市场功能恢复vs双重使命）和实施方式（规模可预测性vs期限构成可预测性），检验流动性效应和存量效应的差异
AI.findings: 1. 当沟通目标是恢复市场功能且实施灵活时，流动性效应显著（相对价格偏差缩小），但存量效应接近零，无刺激作用；2. 当沟通目标与双重使命挂钩，提高购买规模可预测性时，存量效应显著为正；3. 当沟通提高购买期限构成可预测性时，存量效应大幅增强；4. 沟通目标和实施方式共同塑造购买效果
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了央行沟通在资产购买政策效果中的理论框架；2. 区分了流动性效应和存量效应的不同决定因素；3. 揭示了政策可预测性在传导机制中的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行设计量化宽松政策提供了沟通策略指导；2. 明确了不同政策目标需要匹配不同的实施方式；3. 帮助政策制定者更精准地实现特定政策效果

title: RBI Draft Registration Amendment Directions 2026: A Move Toward Proportionate NBFC Regulation-With Caveats
affiliations: Advocate, Kolkata, India

detail.title: RBI Draft Registration Amendment Directions 2026: A Move Toward Proportionate NBFC Regulation-With Caveats
detail.abstract:
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has issued the Draft Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Registration, Exemptions and Framework for Scale Based Regulation) Amendment Directions, 2026(“Draft Directions”), inviting public comments by March 4, 2026.

The draft proposes a targeted recalibration of the NBFC regulatory framework, particularly for smaller, low-risk entities, by introducing a pathway for exemption from registration for select NBFCs. While the policy direction is clearly aligned with risk-based and proportional regulation, certain accompanying clarifications (FAQs) may require refinement to ensure that the intended relief is not diluted in practice. This paper discusses the further refinements required.

AI.tldr: 印度央行发布NBFC监管框架修订草案，针对小型低风险实体引入注册豁免途径，但相关澄清说明需进一步完善以确保政策效果不被打折扣。
AI.research_question: 印度央行针对非银行金融公司的监管框架修订草案中，哪些澄清说明需要进一步完善以确保小型低风险实体能够真正获得注册豁免的政策效果？
AI.motivation: 印度央行提出的NBFC监管框架修订草案旨在为小型低风险实体提供注册豁免途径，实现基于风险的比例监管。然而，草案中的澄清说明可能在实际执行中削弱政策效果，需要进一步分析和完善。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险的监管理论、比例监管原则、金融包容性理论、监管沙盒概念、金融监管的成本效益分析框架。
AI.method: 政策文件分析、监管框架比较研究、利益相关者访谈（如可能）、FAQ内容文本分析、监管影响评估方法。
AI.findings: 草案虽然提出了注册豁免途径，但相关澄清说明中的某些条款可能在实际操作中增加合规负担，导致小型低风险实体难以真正享受政策红利，需要针对具体条款进行细化调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了基于风险的金融监管理论在发展中国家金融包容性背景下的应用，提出了"监管豁免有效性"的概念框架，为比例监管原则的实际操作提供了实证分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度央行完善NBFC监管框架提供具体建议，帮助小型低风险实体真正获得监管豁免，促进金融包容性，为其他新兴市场国家的金融监管改革提供参考。
