title: A 'Digital Dominion': Launching the Commonwealth Model Law on Digital Trade

detail.title: A 'Digital Dominion': Launching the Commonwealth Model Law on Digital Trade

publicationDetails.detailsText: Craig Atkinson, A ‘Digital Dominion’: Launching the Commonwealth Model Law on Digital Trade, Cambridge International Law Journal (Feb. 2026).

detail.abstract: A legislative text published for the benefit of its 56 member countries, the Commonwealth of Nations officially adopted the Model Law on Digital Trade (MLDT) in September 2025. The Commonwealth MLDT addresses a persistent barrier to digital trade (i.e., all trade that is digitally ordered and/or digitally delivered): the laws of many jurisdictions do not sufficiently recognise the legal requirements of electronic commerce (e-commerce) and continue to emphasise paper-bases for commercial communications and transactions in domestic and cross-border contexts.

AI.tldr: 英联邦国家于2025年9月正式通过《数字贸易示范法》，旨在解决数字贸易中因各国法律对电子商务法律要求认可不足、过度依赖纸质文件而造成的持续障碍。
AI.research_question: 英联邦《数字贸易示范法》如何解决成员国在数字贸易中面临的法律障碍，特别是电子商务法律要求认可不足和纸质文件依赖问题？
AI.motivation: 许多司法管辖区的法律未能充分认可电子商务的法律要求，在国内外商业交流和交易中仍过度强调纸质基础，这已成为数字贸易的持续障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字贸易法律框架、电子商务法律认可理论、国际商法协调理论、数字贸易障碍分析框架
AI.method: 立法文本分析、比较法律研究方法、国际组织政策文件分析、成员国法律现状评估
AI.findings: 英联邦通过《数字贸易示范法》为56个成员国提供了统一的法律框架，旨在解决数字贸易中的法律障碍，特别是电子商务法律要求认可不足和纸质文件依赖问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数字贸易法律协调的理论框架，为国际组织制定数字贸易法律标准提供了理论支持，丰富了电子商务法律认可的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英联邦成员国提供了具体的法律改革指导，促进数字贸易发展；为其他国际组织制定类似法律框架提供参考；有助于减少数字贸易中的法律不确定性。

reference: Journal of Palestine Studies, volume 53, issue 1, 2024[10.1080/0377919X.2024.2311043]
title: From Bolsonaro to Lula: Understanding Brazil's Passive Neutrality on Palestine and Israel

detail.title: From Bolsonaro to Lula: Understanding Brazil's Passive Neutrality on Palestine and Israel

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Palestine Studies, volume 53, issue 1, 2024[10.1080/0377919X.2024.2311043]

detail.abstract: This essay examines Brazil’s foreign policy approach toward Palestine and Israel by comparing the administrations of Presidents Jair Bolsonaro and Lula da Silva. In outlining elements of continuity and discontinuity between them, the essay argues that it is necessary to examine Brazil’s strategicdiplomacy regarding Israel’s ongoing illegal occupation of the Palestinian territories and its brutal attacks on Palestinians in light of key structural changes that have occurred in Brazil. These include the growth of the agribusiness sector and the Evangelical Church, both of which have significant influence over the foreign policy choices of successive Brazilian presidential administrations, regardless of their political or ideological leanings. As a result, as this essay shows, neither Bolsonaro nor Lula could fully implementtheir stated agendas toward Palestine and Israel; indeed, despite the latter’s defense of a two-state solution, this will not translate into punitive measuresagainst Israel, especially given the international permissiveness of Israeli crimes.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了巴西博索纳罗和卢拉两届政府对巴以问题的外交政策，发现尽管两届政府意识形态不同，但由于巴西国内农业综合企业和福音派教会的影响力增长，两届政府都无法完全实施其既定议程，卢拉政府虽支持两国方案但不会对以色列采取惩罚性措施。
AI.research_question: 巴西博索纳罗和卢拉两届政府对巴勒斯坦和以色列的外交政策有何异同？国内结构性变化（农业综合企业和福音派教会）如何影响巴西的巴以外交政策选择？
AI.motivation: 理解巴西不同意识形态政府（右翼博索纳罗和左翼卢拉）在巴以问题上的外交政策连续性，探究国内结构性因素如何制约总统的外交政策自主性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外交政策分析、国内政治对外交政策的影响、结构性约束理论、利益集团政治理论。
AI.method: 比较案例研究法，对比分析博索纳罗和卢拉两届政府的巴以外交政策，考察政策连续性和间断性，分析国内结构性因素的作用。
AI.findings: 1. 两届政府都无法完全实施其既定巴以议程；2. 巴西农业综合企业和福音派教会对两届政府的巴以外交政策都有显著影响；3. 尽管卢拉支持两国方案，但不会对以色列采取惩罚性措施；4. 国际社会对以色列行为的纵容进一步限制了巴西的政策选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了国内结构性因素如何超越意识形态差异影响外交政策；2. 提出了农业综合企业和宗教团体作为新兴外交政策影响力量的理论框架；3. 丰富了发展中国家外交政策受国内利益集团制约的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解巴西外交政策制定提供了现实视角；2. 揭示了农业和宗教利益集团在外交政策中的实际影响力；3. 为预测巴西未来巴以外交政策走向提供了分析框架；4. 对国际社会理解发展中国家外交政策制约因素有参考价值。

title: Religion and the Wealth of Nations After 250 Years
affiliations: Monash University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Religion and the Wealth of Nations After 250 Years
detail.abstract: This chapter explores the intersection of religion and economics on the 250th anniversary of Adam Smith’s The Wealth of Nations, first published in 1776. While Smith is often viewed as a secular figure in economics, his work was deeply influenced by the moral philosophy of his time, which was shaped by Christian thought. I discuss how economists think about the religious themes in Smith’s work in the 21st century and review what we know today about the connection between religion and economic outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了亚当·斯密《国富论》出版250周年之际宗教与经济学的交叉点，分析了斯密思想中的宗教主题及其对当代经济学的影响
AI.research_question: 在21世纪，经济学家如何看待亚当·斯密著作中的宗教主题？宗教与经济结果之间有何联系？
AI.motivation: 亚当·斯密常被视为经济学中的世俗人物，但其思想深受当时基督教道德哲学的影响。在《国富论》出版250周年之际，有必要重新审视宗教与经济学的交叉关系
AI.theoretical_framework: 亚当·斯密的道德哲学理论、宗教经济学理论、基督教思想对经济学发展的影响
AI.method: 文献综述、历史分析、理论探讨
AI.findings: 亚当·斯密的思想深受基督教道德哲学影响；宗教因素在经济学发展中扮演重要角色；宗教与经济结果之间存在复杂联系
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定位亚当·斯密思想中的宗教维度；构建宗教与经济学交叉研究的理论框架；挑战经济学纯粹世俗化的传统观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解宗教对经济行为的影响提供新视角；为宗教与经济政策制定提供参考；促进跨学科对话与理解

reference: Quantitative Economics, volume 16, issue 3, 2025[10.3982/QE2465]
title: Inference in a Stationary/nonstationary Autoregressive Time-varying-parameter Model
affiliations: Yale University - Cowles Foundation and National University of Singapore

detail.title: Inference in a Stationary/nonstationary Autoregressive Time-varying-parameter Model

publicationDetails.detailsText: Quantitative Economics, volume 16, issue 3, 2025[10.3982/QE2465]

detail.abstract: This paper considers nonparametric estimation and inference in first-order autoregressive (AR(1)) models with deterministically time-varying parameters. A key feature of the proposed approach is to allow for time-varying stationarity in some time periods, time-varying nonstationarity (i.e., unit root or local-to-unit root behavior) in other periods, and smooth transitions between the two. The estimation of the AR parameter at any time point is based on a local least squares regression method, where the relevant initial condition is endogenous. We obtain limit distributions for the AR parameter estimator and t-statistic at a given point τ in time when the parameter exhibits unit root, local-to-unity, or stationary/stationarylike behavior at time τ. These results are used to construct confidence intervals and median-unbiased interval estimators for the AR parameter at any specified point in time. The confidence intervals have correct asymptotic coverage probabilities with the coverage holding uniformly over stationary and nonstationary behavior of the observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种非参数估计和推断方法，用于处理具有确定性时变参数的一阶自回归模型。该方法允许参数在不同时间段呈现时变平稳性、时变非平稳性（单位根或局部单位根行为），以及两者之间的平滑过渡。通过局部最小二乘回归方法估计任意时间点的AR参数，并考虑了内生初始条件。论文推导了参数在单位根、局部单位根或平稳行为下的极限分布，并基于此构建了具有正确渐近覆盖概率的置信区间。
AI.research_question: 如何在具有确定性时变参数的一阶自回归模型中，对参数进行非参数估计和统计推断，特别是在参数可能在不同时间段呈现平稳性和非平稳性（单位根或局部单位根行为）的情况下？
AI.motivation: 传统的时间序列分析通常假设参数是恒定的，但实际经济金融数据中，参数可能随时间变化。特别是在经济周期、政策变化等情境下，AR参数可能在平稳和非平稳状态之间转换。现有方法难以处理这种时变参数且允许平稳和非平稳状态共存的情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时变参数的一阶自回归模型，允许参数在不同时间段呈现时变平稳性、时变非平稳性（单位根或局部单位根行为），以及两者之间的平滑过渡。理论框架考虑了内生初始条件问题。
AI.method: 采用局部最小二乘回归方法估计任意时间点的AR参数。通过推导参数在单位根、局部单位根或平稳行为下的极限分布，构建置信区间和中位数无偏区间估计量。
AI.findings: 获得了AR参数估计量和t统计量在给定时间点τ的极限分布，无论参数在τ时刻呈现单位根、局部单位根还是平稳行为。基于这些结果构建的置信区间具有正确的渐近覆盖概率，且覆盖概率在观测值的平稳和非平稳行为上保持一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了处理时变参数AR(1)模型的统一框架，允许平稳和非平稳状态共存；2) 推导了参数估计量在不同状态下的极限分布理论；3) 发展了具有均匀覆盖概率的置信区间构造方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为经济金融时间序列分析提供了更灵活的工具，能够捕捉参数的结构性变化；2) 构建的置信区间可用于实际推断，即使在参数状态不确定的情况下也能保证统计可靠性；3) 方法适用于经济周期分析、政策评估等实际应用场景。

title: Mental Models of High School Success
affiliations: , , University of Cologne,  and

detail.title: Mental Models of High School Success
detail.abstract: Using surveys with Danish students transitioning to secondary education, we study mental models of how gender and parental education shape academic performance. Students hold heterogeneous beliefs about performance gaps by gender and parental background, which appear to be shaped by within-family transmission and broader social environments. Open-text responses reveal that respondents link strong performance by girls and less socioeconomically privileged students to effort, while attributing privileged students' success to external advantages. Mental models matter: beliefs about performance gaps predict enrollment in upper secondary education by gender and parental education and causally affect students’ self-assessments, intended effort, and educational aspirations, as shown in an information experiment with girls. We highlight two mechanisms: updating about the returns to effort and about gender-specific effort costs in response to observed gender performance gaps. Our findings advance the understanding of education choices and shed light on the determinants and effects of mental models in a high-stakes setting.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过丹麦学生调查，探讨了学生对性别和父母教育背景如何影响学业成绩的心理模型。研究发现学生对这些差距持有异质性信念，这些信念受家庭内部传递和社会环境影响，并影响他们的教育选择和自我评估。
AI.research_question: 学生如何理解性别和父母教育背景对学业成绩的影响？这些心理模型如何形成，以及它们如何影响学生的教育选择、自我评估和努力意愿？
AI.motivation: 理解学生如何看待教育不平等（性别和社会经济背景差异）的心理模型，以及这些信念如何影响他们的教育决策，对于解释教育选择和设计干预措施具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于心理模型理论、社会认知理论、教育不平等理论，探讨信念形成机制（家庭传递和社会环境）以及信念对行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用丹麦学生调查数据（从基础教育向中等教育过渡阶段），包括问卷调查和开放式文本回答，并进行信息实验（特别是针对女生）来检验因果效应。
AI.findings: 1. 学生对性别和父母教育背景相关的成绩差距持有异质性信念；2. 信念受家庭内部传递和更广泛的社会环境影响；3. 学生将女生和弱势社会经济背景学生的优秀表现归因于努力，而将特权学生的成功归因于外部优势；4. 这些信念预测了按性别和父母教育背景划分的高中入学率；5. 信息实验显示信念因果性地影响学生的自我评估、预期努力和教育抱负；6. 机制包括：关于努力回报的更新，以及对性别特定努力成本的理解。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 推进了对教育选择中心理模型作用的理解；2. 揭示了信念形成和影响的机制；3. 在高风险情境中验证了心理模型的重要性；4. 为理解教育不平等感知提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为教育政策制定者提供了干预学生信念以促进教育公平的途径；2. 揭示了通过信息干预改变学生自我评估和抱负的可能性；3. 为教师和家长如何讨论教育不平等提供了实践启示；4. 有助于设计更有效的教育指导和职业咨询策略。

title: Trustbusters’ Crackdown on Big Tech: An Analysis of Competition Policy and Antitrust Enforcement Efficacy as Reflected in the Securities Market
affiliations: Yuan Ze University and National Chengchi University (NCCU)

detail.title: Trustbusters’ Crackdown on Big Tech: An Analysis of Competition Policy and Antitrust Enforcement Efficacy as Reflected in the Securities Market

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests, affiliations with commercial or not-for-profit entities, or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: The maneuvers of big tech firms with their market power demonstrate considerable similarities in the United States, the European Union, and China. However, we observed a divergent trend in their stock performance. We hypothesized that a company's securities performance could be attributed to regulatory events and differentiated the effects of ex ante competition policy on the performance of big tech firms' securities from those of ex post antitrust enforcement using an event time regression model. Our empirical results show that the ex ante approach is more effective than the ex post one, because the former entails credible policymaking and induces smaller implementation costs. Enforcements against tying arrangements, exclusivity contracts, self-referencing and data misuse are impactful on big tech's securities performance. Behavioral remedies can be more effective when combined with monetary penalties because the latter explicitly signal regulatory certainty.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现事前竞争政策比事后反垄断执法更能有效影响大型科技公司的证券表现，因为前者具有可信的政策制定和更低的实施成本。捆绑安排、排他性合同、自我推荐和数据滥用的执法对科技股表现有显著影响，而行为救济与罚款结合时效果更佳。
AI.research_question: 事前竞争政策与事后反垄断执法对大型科技公司证券表现的影响有何差异？哪些具体的监管措施对科技股表现影响最大？
AI.motivation: 尽管美国、欧盟和中国的大型科技公司市场行为相似，但其股票表现却呈现分化趋势。这种差异可能源于不同的监管方式，需要探究事前竞争政策和事后反垄断执法对证券表现的不同影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于监管经济学和事件研究方法，区分事前竞争政策（ex ante competition policy）和事后反垄断执法（ex post antitrust enforcement）的理论框架，分析监管确定性、实施成本对证券表现的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用事件时间回归模型（event time regression model），分析监管事件对大型科技公司证券表现的影响，区分事前政策和事后执法的不同效应。
AI.findings: 1. 事前竞争政策比事后反垄断执法更有效，因其具有可信的政策制定和更低的实施成本；2. 针对捆绑安排、排他性合同、自我推荐和数据滥用的执法对科技股表现影响显著；3. 行为救济与罚款结合时效果更好，因为罚款明确传达了监管确定性信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统区分事前竞争政策和事后反垄断执法对证券表现的不同影响；2. 提出了监管确定性作为影响证券表现的关键机制；3. 丰富了监管经济学在科技公司证券表现领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构提供了优化监管策略的证据支持，建议优先采用事前政策；2. 为投资者提供了评估监管风险对科技股影响的参考框架；3. 为科技公司合规管理提供了具体指导，重点关注捆绑、排他性合同等高风险领域。

reference: Monetary Authority of Singapore Thematic Review 2026 (Journal)
title: Market Exit Architecture: Call for Regulations in GP-led Investment Fund Restructuring
affiliations: NMIMS University - NMIMS Kirit P. Mehta School of Law

detail.title: Market Exit Architecture: Call for Regulations in GP-led Investment Fund Restructuring

publicationDetails.detailsText: Monetary Authority of Singapore Thematic Review 2026 (Journal)

detail.abstract: This paper examines how GP-led continuation funds have quickly moved from being novel, deal-specific tools to becoming a routine feature of India’s private equity market. It traces the “jurisprudential inversion” whereby sophisticated continuation transactions (Samara, ChrysCapital, Multiples) have evolved faster than the Indian legal and regulatory framework designed to govern them. Against this backdrop, the paper maps the current “regulatory mosaic” of AIF Regulations, SEBI circulars, tax and competition law, and highlights the gaps this creates for conflicts of interest, valuation integrity, and LP protection. Drawing on comparative insights from the US, UK and Singapore, it argues for a dedicated, lex specialis style regime for GP‑led restructurings in India, with formal recognition of continuation vehicles, codified LP election rights, and robust conflict‑management and valuation standards. The paper ultimately positions GP‑led restructurings as a structural instrument of capital recycling in India and sets out concrete policy recommendations for SEBI and RBI to move from reactive accommodation to anticipatory, market‑aligned governance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究印度私募股权市场中GP主导的续存基金如何从新颖的交易工具演变为常规市场特征，分析了法律监管滞后于交易创新的"法理倒置"现象，并提出专门监管框架的政策建议。
AI.research_question: GP主导的续存基金在印度私募股权市场中如何从特殊工具演变为常规特征？法律监管框架如何适应这种快速创新？需要什么样的专门监管制度来管理GP主导的重组交易？
AI.motivation: 印度私募股权市场中GP主导的续存基金快速发展，但法律监管框架滞后，存在利益冲突、估值完整性和有限合伙人保护等方面的监管空白，需要系统性研究并提出政策建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法理倒置理论（jurisprudential inversion）、监管滞后理论、比较法分析（美国、英国、新加坡经验）、专门法（lex specialis）监管框架理论。
AI.method: 案例分析法（Samara、ChrysCapital、Multiples等交易案例）、比较法研究（美国、英国、新加坡监管框架）、监管框架映射分析（AIF法规、SEBI通告、税法、竞争法）。
AI.findings: 1. GP主导的续存基金在印度已从特殊工具变为常规市场特征；2. 存在"法理倒置"现象：复杂交易创新快于法律监管；3. 当前监管框架呈现"监管马赛克"状态，存在利益冲突、估值和LP保护等监管空白。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"法理倒置"概念解释印度私募股权市场的监管滞后现象；2. 建立GP主导重组作为资本循环结构工具的理论框架；3. 为新兴市场金融创新监管提供理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为SEBI和RBI提供具体政策建议：建立专门监管框架、正式承认续存工具、编纂LP选择权、强化利益冲突管理和估值标准；2. 推动印度从被动适应转向前瞻性、市场导向的监管治理。

reference: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No.26-005
title: ECB Council Members’ Objectives and Public Debt at Home – Evidence From an AI-Based Textual Analysis
affiliations: ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research and ZEW Mannheim

detail.title: ECB Council Members’ Objectives and Public Debt at Home – Evidence From an AI-Based Textual Analysis

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No.26-005
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the changing attention that ECB Governing Council members pay to different policy objectives by analysing more than 4,600 speeches given between the establishment of the ECB and the summer of 2024. Alongside the primary objective of price stability, we consider the following potential secondary objectives: financial stability, stability of the government bond market, sustainable public debt, climate protection and distribution. On the methodological side, we take advantage of LLMs to identify the speeches’ coverage of each of these objectives and the associated support. We conduct a series of validation tests to verify our AI-based scores, including a conventional dictionary approach. We use two-way fixed effects regressions to search for a link between a country's level of public debt and the objective function of its representatives. The results suggest that objectives have become more diverse in recent years. An increase in the public debt-to-GDP ratio in a governor’s home country is associated with a shift in focus away from the primary objective and towards a growing coverage and support for secondary objectives. This general pattern is particularly robust for the distribution objective. These results can only be partly explained by governor selection. Therefore, in their communication, individual governors indicate shifts in their objective function in response to changes in the fiscal situation of their home country.

AI.tldr: 本文使用LLM分析ECB理事会成员4600多篇演讲，发现随着成员国公共债务增加，其代表会减少对价格稳定主要目标的关注，转而更关注金融稳定、债务可持续性、气候保护等次要目标，特别是分配目标。
AI.research_question: ECB理事会成员的政策目标关注度如何随时间变化？成员国公共债务水平是否影响其代表的政策目标偏好？
AI.motivation: 理解ECB决策者在沟通中如何平衡主要目标（价格稳定）与各种次要目标，以及财政状况如何影响他们的政策偏好。
AI.theoretical_framework: 中央银行目标函数理论，ECB法定目标框架（价格稳定为主要目标），成员国财政状况对央行代表行为的影响理论。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型分析4600多篇ECB理事会成员演讲（1998-2024年），识别对价格稳定、金融稳定、政府债券市场稳定、公共债务可持续性、气候保护、分配等目标的覆盖度和支持度。采用双向固定效应回归分析公共债务-GDP比率与目标偏好的关系，并进行验证测试。
AI.findings: 1. 近年来ECB理事会成员的政策目标变得更加多样化；2. 成员国公共债务-GDP比率上升与其代表减少对主要目标（价格稳定）的关注相关；3. 债务增加与对次要目标（特别是分配目标）的关注和支持增加相关；4. 这一模式不能完全用理事选择机制解释，表明个体理事确实会根据母国财政状况调整目标函数。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为ECB理事会成员目标函数动态变化提供实证证据；2. 揭示成员国财政状况如何影响央行代表的政策偏好；3. 展示LLM在政策文本分析中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助理解ECB政策沟通的演变；2. 为评估央行独立性受财政压力影响提供依据；3. 为政策制定者了解不同目标间的权衡提供参考。

title: Science under Threat? A Natural Experiment in Economics
affiliations: University of Lausanne, Paris School of Economics (PSE) and Paris School of Economics (PSE)

detail.title: Science under Threat? A Natural Experiment in Economics
detail.abstract: Academic freedom has come under growing strain across the world. To study whether and how academics react to political pressure, we exploit a natural experiment: the U.S. government's ``blacklist'' of undesirable words released in early 2025. We find that the release of this list leads to a sharp reduction in the use of banned words in sensitive contexts among economists working at universities that rely heavily on NSF funding. The drop is particularly marked for content related to gender, race, and environment. Our findings are consistent with scholars responding strongly to political pressure through career incentives.

AI.tldr: 美国政府2025年发布"禁用词黑名单"后，依赖NSF资助的大学经济学家在敏感语境中使用禁用词的数量急剧下降，特别是在性别、种族和环境相关领域，表明学者通过职业激励对政治压力做出强烈反应。
AI.research_question: 学者是否以及如何对政治压力做出反应？具体而言，美国政府发布的"禁用词黑名单"如何影响经济学家在学术研究中的语言使用？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内学术自由面临日益增长的压力，需要实证研究学者在面对政治压力时的实际反应机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于职业激励理论和政治压力对学术行为的影响框架，探讨学者在面临政治压力时的适应性行为。
AI.method: 利用自然实验方法，分析美国政府在2025年初发布的"禁用词黑名单"对经济学家语言使用的影响，特别关注依赖NSF资助的大学。
AI.findings: 黑名单发布后，依赖NSF资助的大学经济学家在敏感语境中使用禁用词的数量急剧下降，特别是在性别、种族和环境相关领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政治压力如何通过职业激励影响学术行为提供了实证证据，深化了对学术自由与政治干预关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了政治压力对学术研究的实际影响机制，为学术机构和政策制定者提供了关于学术自由保护的实证依据。

reference: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 5
title: Expectations, Unemployment and Inflation: an Empirical Investigation

detail.title: Expectations, Unemployment and Inflation: an Empirical Investigation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 5
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper analyses the empirical relation between inflation and unemployment over the past 25 years by using a panel state-space model. After controlling for the global factor, I find that the domestic rate of unemployment explains 11 percent in the variation of headline inflation, suggesting a significant power that domestic slack has in influencing medium-term core inflation. The global factor, in turn, is well explained by global oil and food prices as well as global trade integration. The contribution of the global slack in explaining the global component of inflation is negligible. Additionally, using a set of threshold regressions, I identify break points that split inflation dynamics into various regimes. In particular, I find a higher sensitivity of inflation to unemployment in high-inflation and/or low unemployment regimes. This finding is consistent with less frequent price adjustments of firms in low-inflation and high-unemployment environments.

AI.tldr: 本文使用面板状态空间模型分析了过去25年通胀与失业率的经验关系，发现国内失业率能解释11%的总体通胀变化，表明国内经济疲软对中期核心通胀有显著影响。全球因素主要由全球油价、食品价格和贸易一体化解释，而全球疲软对通胀的全球成分贡献可忽略。阈值回归识别了通胀动态的不同制度，发现在高通胀和/或低失业率制度下，通胀对失业率更敏感。
AI.research_question: 过去25年通胀与失业率之间的经验关系是什么？国内经济疲软和全球因素各自对通胀变化有多大解释力？通胀动态是否存在不同的制度，且在不同制度下通胀对失业率的敏感性是否不同？
AI.motivation: 理解通胀与失业率之间的关系对货币政策制定至关重要。传统菲利普斯曲线关系近年来受到挑战，需要重新评估国内经济疲软和全球因素在通胀动态中的相对重要性，特别是在全球化背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 菲利普斯曲线理论，面板状态空间模型，阈值回归模型，全球因素与国内因素对通胀影响的分解。
AI.method: 使用面板状态空间模型分析25年数据，控制全球因素；采用阈值回归识别通胀动态的制度变化点。
AI.findings: 1. 国内失业率能解释11%的总体通胀变化，表明国内经济疲软对中期核心通胀有显著影响；2. 全球因素主要由全球油价、食品价格和贸易一体化解释；3. 全球疲软对通胀的全球成分贡献可忽略；4. 在高通胀和/或低失业率制度下，通胀对失业率更敏感，这与低通胀高失业环境下企业价格调整频率较低一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化了国内经济疲软对通胀的影响程度；2. 区分了全球因素中不同成分的作用；3. 识别了通胀动态的制度依赖性，为非线性菲利普斯曲线提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为货币政策制定者提供了通胀预测的实证依据；2. 强调了在不同经济环境下通胀对失业率敏感性的差异；3. 帮助政策制定者更好地理解全球因素和国内因素在通胀动态中的相对重要性。

title: Inference for Matched Difference-in-Differences
affiliations: Korea University

detail.title: Inference for Matched Difference-in-Differences
detail.abstract: Matched difference-indifferences (MDID) estimators are widely used, yet matching induces a dependence structure that complicates variance estimation. In particular, covariate-based matching generates positive correlation within matched pairs, which implies a reduction in the variance of the difference-indifferences (DID) estimator. Standard variance estimators, however, fail to account for this design-induced covariance, yielding systematically conservative standard errors. To address this issue, we characterize the asymptotic variance implied by the matched design and propose a projection-based variance estimator that removes variation attributable to the matching covariates through orthogonal projection. Simulation results show that the proposed estimator achieves accurate coverage, while standard methods substantially overestimate uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文针对匹配双重差分（MDID）估计中匹配导致的依赖结构问题，提出了一种基于投影的方差估计方法，解决了标准方差估计过于保守的问题。
AI.research_question: 匹配双重差分（MDID）估计中，如何正确估计匹配设计导致的方差减少，从而获得准确的标准误？
AI.motivation: MDID估计器被广泛使用，但匹配过程会引入依赖结构，导致方差估计复杂化。协变量匹配会在匹配对之间产生正相关，从而降低DID估计器的方差。然而，标准方差估计方法未能考虑这种设计导致的协方差，导致系统性地保守的标准误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 匹配双重差分（MDID）理论，方差估计理论，正交投影方法
AI.method: 通过正交投影去除匹配协变量带来的变异，提出基于投影的方差估计方法，并通过模拟研究验证其性能
AI.findings: 模拟结果显示，提出的估计方法能够达到准确的覆盖率，而标准方法则显著高估了不确定性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 刻画了匹配设计所隐含的渐近方差特征；2. 提出了基于正交投影的方差估计方法；3. 理论上解释了匹配导致的方差减少机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为MDID估计提供了更准确的标准误计算方法；2. 避免了标准方法过度保守的问题；3. 提高了实证研究的统计推断准确性

title: Did Foreigners Pay America’s Tariffs? Quantity Discounts, Scale Economies and Incomplete Pass-Through
affiliations: Georgetown University and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Did Foreigners Pay America’s Tariffs? Quantity Discounts, Scale Economies and Incomplete Pass-Through
detail.abstract: Transaction-level quantity discounts are a pervasive feature of US trade, shaping both price variation and tariff incidence. Using administrative microdata, we show that these discounts reflect transaction-level scale economies rather than market power. Accounting for these micro-level economies resolves a key puzzle: while observed import prices rose one-for-one with 2018-2019 US tariffs, we show this was driven by the loss of scale economies as transaction sizes collapsed. Controlling for this scale effect, the strategic pass-through of tariffs to scale-free prices falls to 60 percent, implying foreign exporters absorbed a significant share of the burden through reduced markups.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用行政微观数据发现，美国贸易中的交易级数量折扣反映了规模经济而非市场力量。这一发现解释了2018-2019年美国关税期间观察到的进口价格与关税同步上涨的谜题：实际上是由于交易规模萎缩导致规模经济丧失所致。控制规模效应后，关税的战略性转嫁率降至60%，表明外国出口商通过降低利润率吸收了相当一部分关税负担。
AI.research_question: 交易级数量折扣的本质是什么？它们如何影响关税转嫁和关税负担分配？
AI.motivation: 美国贸易中普遍存在的交易级数量折扣现象对价格变化和关税负担分配有重要影响，但对其本质（规模经济还是市场力量）存在争议。2018-2019年美国关税期间观察到的进口价格与关税同步上涨的现象需要解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规模经济理论、关税转嫁理论、不完全竞争市场理论、交易成本理论
AI.method: 使用行政微观数据进行分析，通过控制交易规模变化来分离规模效应和战略性价格调整效应
AI.findings: 1. 交易级数量折扣主要反映规模经济而非市场力量；2. 2018-2019年进口价格与关税同步上涨主要是由于交易规模萎缩导致规模经济丧失；3. 控制规模效应后，关税的战略性转嫁率从100%降至60%；4. 外国出口商通过降低利润率吸收了约40%的关税负担
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确了交易级数量折扣的规模经济本质；2. 提供了分离规模效应和战略性价格调整的方法；3. 修正了关税转嫁理论，考虑了微观层面的规模经济效应
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了更准确的关税影响评估工具；2. 帮助企业理解贸易政策变化对交易规模和价格的影响；3. 为贸易谈判提供了关于关税负担分配的新证据

reference: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No.26-006
title: Fundamentally Reforming the DI System: Evidence from Germany
affiliations: ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research, ZEW Mannheim, German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin) and Cornell University

detail.title: Fundamentally Reforming the DI System: Evidence from Germany

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No.26-006
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: In 2001, Germany abolished public occupational disability insurance (ODI)-the second tier of its public DI system-for cohorts born after 1960. Using administrative data, we first document that, in the long run, overall DI inflows declined by roughly one-third. Second, using representative survey data, we document at best modest ODI insurance take-up responses in the private individual, risk-rated market, which lacks guaranteed issue. Third, an equilibrium model incorporating interactions between the public safety net, the first-tier public DI, and the private market reveals that coverage denials and weak insurance demand, driven by complementary social insurance, can explain the modest private ODI take-up response. Coverage gradients by income and health are thus substantial. Finally, counterfactual simulations highlight the limited scope of incremental reforms.

AI.tldr: 德国2001年废除了1960年后出生人群的公共职业残疾保险（ODI），研究发现长期来看总体残疾保险流入减少了约三分之一，但私人保险市场替代有限，主要原因是承保拒绝和保险需求不足，导致收入和健康差异显著影响保险覆盖。
AI.research_question: 废除公共职业残疾保险后，私人保险市场的替代效果如何？哪些因素影响了私人ODI保险的购买？
AI.motivation: 德国2001年改革废除了部分人群的公共职业残疾保险，这为研究公共保险改革对私人保险市场的影响提供了自然实验机会，有助于理解社会保险与私人保险的互动关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 均衡模型结合公共安全网、第一层公共残疾保险和私人市场的相互作用，分析保险需求、承保拒绝和互补性社会保险对私人保险购买的影响。
AI.method: 使用行政数据分析长期残疾保险流入变化，使用代表性调查数据分析私人保险购买行为，建立均衡模型解释私人保险替代有限的原因，并进行反事实模拟。
AI.findings: 1. 长期来看总体残疾保险流入减少了约三分之一；2. 私人保险市场替代有限，购买响应微弱；3. 承保拒绝和保险需求不足是主要原因；4. 收入和健康状况显著影响保险覆盖差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了分析公共保险改革对私人市场影响的均衡框架；2. 揭示了互补性社会保险如何削弱私人保险需求；3. 解释了保险覆盖在收入和健康维度上的梯度差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供改革效果评估；2. 揭示渐进式改革的局限性；3. 为保险市场设计提供实证依据；4. 帮助理解社会保险与私人保险的互动机制。

title: The Inequality Elasticity of Demand

detail.title: The Inequality Elasticity of Demand

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Inequality Elasticity of Demand (IED), a reduced-form measure that captures the sensitivity of aggregate consumption to changes in the income distribution, holding total income constant. The IED arises naturally from heterogeneity in marginal propensities to consume across income groups and reflects the fact that distributional shifts alter aggregate demand even when aggregate income is unchanged. By aggregating group-specific consumption behavior using observed income shares, the paper shows how inequality generates systematic variation in aggregate consumption through purely compositional effects. The IED is constructed using standard ingredients —income shares and group-level marginal propensities to consume—and can be implemented straightforwardly using distributional national accounts without imposing additional structural assumptions. The paper emphasizes interpretation, scope, and limitations, positioning the IED as a descriptive complement to existing inequality and consumption metrics rather than a substitute for structural modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"需求不平等弹性"(IED)这一简化测量指标，用于衡量在总收入不变的情况下，总消费对收入分配变化的敏感度。IED源于不同收入群体边际消费倾向的异质性，反映了即使总收入不变，分配变化也会改变总需求。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够捕捉收入分配变化对总消费影响的简化测量指标？
AI.motivation: 现有研究认识到收入分配变化会影响总需求，但缺乏一个简单、可操作的测量工具来量化这种影响。需要开发一个不依赖复杂结构假设的描述性指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不同收入群体边际消费倾向的异质性理论，以及收入分配通过组成效应影响总消费的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用标准要素构建IED：收入份额和群体层面的边际消费倾向。通过观察到的收入份额汇总群体特定的消费行为，利用分配性国民账户数据实施，无需额外结构假设。
AI.findings: 不平等通过纯粹的组成效应产生总消费的系统性变化。IED能够捕捉收入分配变化对总消费的敏感性，即使总收入保持不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个理论框架，将收入分配变化与总消费联系起来；发展了IED作为衡量分配变化对总需求影响的简化指标；阐明了不平等通过组成效应对宏观经济的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了易于实施的测量工具，使用现有分配性国民账户数据即可计算；为政策制定者评估收入分配变化对总需求的影响提供实用指标；作为现有不平等和消费指标的补充描述性工具。

title: Energy for Growth: Satellite Synthetic Control Evidence from Indonesia
affiliations: ,  and FernUniversitat in Hagen

detail.title: Energy for Growth: Satellite Synthetic Control Evidence from Indonesia
detail.abstract: This study evaluates the causal impact of Indonesia's Power Transmission Development Project on regional economic development. Employing the Generalized Synthetic Control Method on district-level satellite data, we find a statistically significant increase in economic activity (p=0.033), which translates to a GDP increase of approximately 1.35 percent based on empirically derived nightlight-GDP elasticities. These findings provide rigorous ex-post evidence supporting the economic returns to infrastructure investments in middle-income countries, while demonstrating how satellite imagery combined with quasi-experimental methods can enable credible impact evaluation where traditional data are scarce.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用广义合成控制方法评估印尼电力传输发展项目对区域经济发展的因果影响，发现项目显著提升了经济活动（GDP约增长1.35%），为中等收入国家基础设施投资的经济回报提供了严谨的事后证据。
AI.research_question: 印尼电力传输发展项目对区域经济发展有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 在传统数据稀缺的情况下，需要评估基础设施投资的经济回报，特别是中等收入国家的基础设施项目效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施投资与经济发展理论，区域经济增长理论，因果推断方法在政策评估中的应用。
AI.method: 采用广义合成控制方法，结合地区层面的卫星数据（夜间灯光数据），使用实证推导的夜间灯光-GDP弹性系数进行经济效应量化。
AI.findings: 电力传输项目对经济活动有统计显著的正向影响（p=0.033），基于夜间灯光-GDP弹性系数计算，GDP约增长1.35%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为基础设施投资的经济回报理论提供了严谨的因果证据；展示了卫星影像与准实验方法结合在传统数据稀缺环境下进行可信影响评估的方法论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中等收入国家基础设施投资决策提供了实证支持；展示了利用卫星数据和准实验方法在数据有限环境中进行政策评估的实用方案。

title: Wealth of Nations vs. Identity of Nations: Gains from Trade and the Erosion of Social Cohesion
affiliations: and

detail.title: Wealth of Nations vs. Identity of Nations: Gains from Trade and the Erosion of Social Cohesion
detail.abstract: We interpret the increased polarization in Western societies over global economic issues as an interaction of economic forces and shifts in a society’s social identity equilibrium. We combine social identity theory with standard small open economy model of international trade to study the effect of economic globalization with a bias towards "unethical" production. Starting from a social cohesion equilibrium where all consumers identify with society at large, we find that a falling price of the unethical variety leads to an erosion of social cohesion and can ultimately lead to a polarized social identity equilibrium where caring consumers are estranged from the society they live in. We show that this form of economic globalization is not only not always a Pareto improvement, but may even lead to aggregate welfare losses.

AI.tldr: 本文结合社会认同理论与标准小国开放经济模型，研究偏向"不道德"生产的全球化如何通过经济力量与社会认同均衡的互动导致社会极化。研究发现，不道德产品价格下降会侵蚀社会凝聚力，最终导致关心道德的消费者与社会疏离的极化均衡，这种全球化不仅不总是帕累托改进，甚至可能导致总体福利损失。
AI.research_question: 经济全球化（特别是偏向"不道德"生产的全球化）如何通过经济力量与社会认同均衡的互动影响社会极化？
AI.motivation: 西方社会在全球经济问题上的极化现象日益加剧，这不仅仅是经济问题，还涉及社会认同的变化。作者希望理解经济全球化如何与社会认同动态相互作用，特别是当全球化偏向"不道德"生产时对社会凝聚力的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 社会认同理论：解释个体如何通过社会分类形成群体认同
2. 标准小国开放经济模型：分析国际贸易的经济效应
3. 两种均衡状态：社会凝聚力均衡（所有消费者认同整个社会）和极化社会认同均衡（关心道德的消费者与社会疏离）
AI.method: 理论建模方法：将社会认同理论整合到标准小国开放经济模型中，构建一个包含"不道德"生产偏好的全球化分析框架，通过均衡分析研究价格变化对社会认同和社会福利的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 不道德产品价格下降会侵蚀社会凝聚力
2. 可能导致从社会凝聚力均衡向极化社会认同均衡的转变
3. 关心道德的消费者可能变得与社会疏离
4. 这种形式的全球化不总是帕累托改进
5. 甚至可能导致总体福利损失
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次将社会认同理论与国际贸易模型相结合
2. 提出了经济力量与社会认同均衡互动的分析框架
3. 解释了全球化如何通过影响社会认同导致社会极化
4. 扩展了对全球化福利效应的理解，包括社会认同维度
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为理解西方社会极化现象提供了新的理论视角
2. 揭示了全球化政策需要考虑社会认同影响
3. 表明单纯的经济效率分析可能忽视重要的社会成本
4. 为政策制定者提供了评估全球化综合影响的框架

title: Scalable Onboarding Architectures for Global API Ecosystems in Multi-Tenant Azure Environments

detail.title: Scalable Onboarding Architectures for Global API Ecosystems in Multi-Tenant Azure Environments
detail.abstract: In modern enterprise ecosystems, the manual onboarding of diverse platforms onto a centralized API gateway presents significant scalability challenges. This paper presents a novel architectural framework for a "Global API" portal designed to automate the ingestion, validation, and management of third-party platforms. Leveraging Microsoft Azure DevOps for continuous integration and a microservices-based backend (Node.js) with a React frontend, the system addresses critical bottlenecks in multi-tenant environments. We demonstrate how this architecture reduces onboarding time by approximately 50% while ensuring strict compliance with security protocols. This case study provides a blueprint for large-scale enterprises managing complex API dependencies across distributed data centers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"全局API"门户的架构框架，通过自动化第三方平台的接入、验证和管理，解决了企业生态系统中API网关手动上线的可扩展性挑战。该系统利用Azure DevOps实现持续集成，采用Node.js微服务后端和React前端，在多租户环境中将上线时间减少约50%，同时确保严格的安全协议合规性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个自动化架构框架，以解决企业生态系统中多样化平台到集中式API网关的手动上线带来的可扩展性挑战？
AI.motivation: 现代企业生态系统中，将多样化平台手动上线到集中式API网关存在显著的可扩展性挑战，这限制了企业处理复杂API依赖关系的能力，特别是在分布式数据中心环境中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于微服务架构理论、DevOps实践和API管理理论，构建了一个自动化API门户的理论框架，强调持续集成、多租户环境管理和安全合规性。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，设计并实现了一个基于Microsoft Azure DevOps的持续集成系统，结合Node.js微服务后端和React前端的技术架构，通过实际部署验证系统效果。
AI.findings: 该架构框架能够将平台上线时间减少约50%，同时确保严格的安全协议合规性，为管理分布式数据中心中复杂API依赖关系的大型企业提供了有效解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个自动化API门户的架构理论框架，扩展了微服务和DevOps理论在API管理领域的应用，为大规模企业环境中的API集成提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大型企业提供了一个可实施的蓝图，用于管理复杂API依赖关系，显著提高上线效率，确保安全合规，并支持多租户环境中的可扩展性需求。

title: From Centralized Heat to Electrified Resilience: A Post-Conflict Energy Reconstruction Framework for Ukraine
affiliations: Independent Policy Researcher

detail.title: From Centralized Heat to Electrified Resilience: A Post-Conflict Energy Reconstruction Framework for Ukraine

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patients, or identifiable personal data. Therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Ukraine's recurring winter heating crisis has often been framed as a mere shortage of fuel-coal, gas, or electricity. This paper argues that such interpretations fundamentally misdiagnose the systemic vulnerability. The core weakness lies in the legacy architecture of Soviet-era Centralized District Heating (CDH) systems, which prioritize economies of scale and centralized control over operational resilience under kinetic conflict conditions. Utilizing a multidisciplinary analytical framework integrating thermodynamic constraints and strategic resilience theory, this paper proposes a post-conflict reconstruction model centered on Decentralized Electrification. By shifting heat production from vulnerable thermal networks to localized, electrically driven systems-utilizing high-efficiency Heat Pumps (HPs), electric boilers, and modular thermal storage-the proposed approach eliminates single points of failure. The analysis suggests that while initial capital expenditure requirements are significant, the resulting architecture enables graceful degradation under attack and enhances longterm economic sovereignty. The framework is designed as a modular and scalable template for post-war Ukraine, with broader applicability to other conflict-prone and infrastructure-vulnerable states.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为乌克兰冬季供暖危机的根本原因不是燃料短缺，而是苏联时代集中式区域供热系统的脆弱性。论文提出以分散式电气化为中心的重建模型，通过热泵、电锅炉和模块化储热等本地化电气系统替代脆弱的集中供热网络，提高系统在冲突条件下的韧性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够提高乌克兰在冲突条件下供暖系统韧性的后冲突重建模型？
AI.motivation: 乌克兰反复出现的冬季供暖危机通常被错误地归因于燃料短缺，而实际上根本问题是苏联时代集中式区域供热系统的结构性脆弱性，这些系统在冲突条件下缺乏韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合热力学约束和战略韧性理论的多学科分析框架，强调系统在受到攻击时的优雅降级能力和长期经济主权。
AI.method: 采用多学科分析框架，结合热力学原理和战略韧性理论，提出分散式电气化重建模型，分析其技术可行性和战略优势。
AI.findings: 分散式电气化模型虽然初始资本支出较高，但能够消除单点故障，使系统在受到攻击时能够优雅降级，同时增强长期经济主权。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合热力学约束和战略韧性理论的分析框架，为冲突地区基础设施重建提供了新的理论视角，强调系统韧性而非单纯效率的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰战后重建提供了模块化、可扩展的分散式电气化模板，该模型也可应用于其他冲突易发和基础设施脆弱的国家。

title: From Gross to Net: Carbon Dioxide Removal in an Analytic Climate Economy
affiliations: , German Centre for Integrative Biodiversity Research (iDiv) Halle-Jena-Leipzig, Kiel Institute for the World Economy,  and University of Oslo

detail.title: From Gross to Net: Carbon Dioxide Removal in an Analytic Climate Economy
detail.abstract: Carbon dioxide removal (CDR) is considered essential for climate change mitigation, yet its optimal role in climate policy remains unclear in the presence of non-permanent storage, energy constraints, and fossil fuel scarcity. We integrate CDR into an analytic integrated assessment model to derive general conditions for socially optimal CDR deployment. Within a linear carbon cycle model, we consider diﬀerent CDR pathways, including direct air carbon capture, ocean alkalinity enhancement, and ocean iron fertilization. Introducing CDR does not significantly alter the optimal carbon price and the incentive to reduce emissions. The impact of CDR on gross emissions mainly stems from the energy required to operate it. This impact, as well as the optimal deployment of CDR, depends on fossil fuel scarcity and the pace of renewable energy deployment. In high-damage scenarios, the optimal deployment of CDR occurs before and around the year 2100, consistent with temperature overshoot pathways.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过集成评估模型分析二氧化碳移除(CDR)在气候政策中的最优部署，发现CDR不会显著改变最优碳价和减排激励，其影响主要来自运行所需的能源，且最优部署取决于化石燃料稀缺性和可再生能源发展速度。
AI.research_question: 在存在非永久性储存、能源约束和化石燃料稀缺的情况下，二氧化碳移除(CDR)在气候政策中的最优角色是什么？
AI.motivation: CDR被认为是气候变化减缓的关键手段，但其在气候政策中的最优作用仍不明确，特别是在考虑非永久性储存、能源约束和化石燃料稀缺等因素时。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集成评估模型(IAM)，线性碳循环模型，社会最优决策框架，考虑不同CDR途径（直接空气碳捕集、海洋碱化增强、海洋铁施肥）。
AI.method: 将CDR整合到分析性集成评估模型中，推导CDR社会最优部署的一般条件，使用线性碳循环模型分析不同CDR途径。
AI.findings: 1. 引入CDR不会显著改变最优碳价和减排激励；2. CDR对总排放的影响主要来自其运行所需的能源；3. CDR的最优部署取决于化石燃料稀缺性和可再生能源发展速度；4. 在高损害情景下，CDR的最优部署发生在2100年前后，与温度超调路径一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了考虑CDR的集成评估分析框架；2. 推导了CDR社会最优部署的一般条件；3. 阐明了CDR与能源系统、化石燃料稀缺性的相互作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为气候政策制定者提供了CDR部署的决策依据；2. 强调了能源系统转型对CDR有效性的重要性；3. 为温度超调情景下的CDR部署提供了时间框架指导。

title: The Post-Chevron Law of Deference for Investor-State Arbitration
affiliations: Villanova University

detail.title: The Post-Chevron Law of Deference for Investor-State Arbitration

publicationDetails.detailsText: Washington University Global Studies Law Review | Vol. 25:1 | 2025

detail.abstract:
This article examines the concept and function of deference in investor–state dispute settlement (ISDS) through comparative analysis with the United States Supreme Court’s recent decision in Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo, which overruled the four‑decade‑old Chevron doctrine. While the overruling of Chevron is widely understood as eliminating judicial deference to administrative interpretations of ambiguous statutes, this article argues that Loper Bright contains a critically overlooked clarification: a firm distinction between (1) mandatory non‑deference on questions of law under §706 of the Administrative Procedure Act (APA), and (2) mandatory deference to agency fact‑finding and policy judgments under §706(2)(A)’s “arbitrary and capricious” standard.

This distinction provides a compelling and analytically rigorous framework for ISDS tribunals, which frequently must review host‑state regulatory, administrative, and judicial actions under treaty standards such as Fair and Equitable Treatment (FET) and indirect expropriation. Although these standards centrally turn on whether state conduct is “arbitrary and capricious,” ISDS tribunals have applied the doctrine of deference inconsistently—sometimes deferring to state authorities, but often engaging in de novo review of factual and policy determinations despite their institutional distance from the underlying decision‑making context. This inconsistency has contributed to a well‑recognized legitimacy crisis marked by unpredictability, fragmentation, and incoherence in ISDS jurisprudence.

The article demonstrates that Loper Bright’s analytical framework, properly understood, aligns with and reinforces the core logic of established ISDS jurisprudence, including Waste Management, S.D. Myers, Electrabel, and Lemire. Tribunals should: (1) decide questions of treaty interpretation independently, without deference to the state’s legal characterization of its obligations; but (2) defer to the state’s factual determinations and policy choices unless the claimant proves arbitrariness, caprice, or a denial of due process. Properly applied, this approach clarifies the law of deference in ISDS as a rule of decision—not a discretionary standard of review—and offers a pathway toward greater coherence, methodological discipline, and legitimacy in international investment law.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较美国最高法院推翻Chevron原则的Loper Bright案，为ISDS中的尊重原则提供了分析框架：法律问题不尊重，事实和政策判断应尊重，除非存在任意或武断。
AI.research_question: 如何在投资者-国家争端解决中建立一致且分析严谨的尊重原则框架？
AI.motivation: ISDS仲裁庭在审查东道国行为时对尊重原则的应用不一致，导致裁决不可预测、碎片化和不连贯，引发了ISDS的合法性危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴美国行政法中的尊重原则理论，特别是Loper Bright案确立的分析框架：区分法律问题的非尊重审查与事实/政策判断的尊重审查。
AI.method: 比较分析法：将美国最高法院Loper Bright案的判决与ISDS仲裁实践进行比较分析，并结合Waste Management、S.D. Myers、Electrabel、Lemire等ISDS案例进行论证。
AI.findings: Loper Bright案的分析框架与ISDS既有判例法逻辑一致，仲裁庭应独立解释条约义务，但对国家的事实认定和政策选择应予以尊重，除非证明存在任意、武断或程序不公。
AI.theory_contributions: 为ISDS中的尊重原则提供了清晰的理论框架，将其从自由裁量的审查标准转变为决策规则，增强了国际投资法的分析严谨性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ISDS仲裁庭提供了具体的操作指南，有助于提高裁决的一致性、可预测性和合法性，缓解ISDS的合法性危机。

title: Temporal Scarcity in Mechanism Design: A Decentralized Approach to Public Goods Provision
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Temporal Scarcity in Mechanism Design: A Decentralized Approach to Public Goods Provision
detail.abstract: This paper addresses the fundamental challenge of public goods provision-the Samuelsonian Dilemma-by proposing a decentralized mechanism termed Citizen's Executive Right (CER). Unlike traditional central-planning models, the CER mechanism endows agents with dispositional authority over tax revenues via Personal Public Accounts (PPAs). We introduce Temporal Scarcity-enforced by a "Rule of Lapsing"-as an information-forcing operator that collapses strategic delay into discrete preference signals. Our theoretical contributions are threefold: 1. Incentive Compatibility: We prove that under loss aversion, the mechanism achieves a symmetric Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium that is "detail-free" (Wilson Doctrine). 2. The Extended Walras's Law: We derive an identity showing that the clearing of the public sphere, measured by the Total Lapsing Rate ($\Lambda_t$), is a sufficient condition for general equilibrium. 3. Dynamic Stability: Using the Routh-Hurwitz criteria, we demonstrate that the balanced equilibrium is locally asymptotically stable, where the temporal pressure acts as a feedback operator. Our results suggest that institutionalizing time-limited dispositional rights can resolve the structural void in public finance, providing a robust blueprint for market-based public governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出公民执行权机制，通过个人公共账户和时间稀缺性解决公共品供给的萨缪尔森困境，证明该机制具有激励相容性、扩展瓦尔拉斯定律和动态稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个去中心化机制来解决公共品供给的萨缪尔森困境？
AI.motivation: 传统中央规划模型在公共品供给中存在效率问题，需要探索基于市场的公共治理新范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 萨缪尔森困境、损失厌恶理论、完美贝叶斯均衡、威尔逊原则、扩展瓦尔拉斯定律、鲁斯-赫尔维茨稳定性判据。
AI.method: 理论建模：提出公民执行权机制，引入个人公共账户和时间稀缺性（失效规则），进行博弈论分析和动态系统稳定性证明。
AI.findings: 1. 在损失厌恶下，机制实现激励相容的对称完美贝叶斯均衡；2. 推导出扩展瓦尔拉斯定律，证明公共领域清算是一般均衡的充分条件；3. 平衡均衡是局部渐近稳定的。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出基于时间稀缺性的信息强制机制；2. 建立扩展瓦尔拉斯定律；3. 证明动态稳定性，为市场型公共治理提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共财政结构性空白提供解决方案，为基于市场的公共治理提供制度设计蓝图，通过时间限制的处置权提高公共资源配置效率。

title: Forecasting House Prices
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements (BIS)

detail.title: Forecasting House Prices

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest do declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No participants involved in study. Also does not characterize a country specific case study.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding used.

detail.abstract: This article identifies the factors that drove house prices in 13 advanced countries over the past 35 years. It does so based on Breiman's (2001) random forest model. Shapley values indicate that annual house price growth across countries is explained first and foremost by price momentum, initial valuations (proxied by price to rent ratios) and household credit growth. Partial effects of explanatory variables are also elicited and suggest important non-linearities, for instance as to what concerns the effects of CPI inflation on house price growth. The out-of-sample forecast test reveals that the random forest model delivers 44% lower house price variation RMSEs and 45% lower MAEs when compared to an OLS model that uses the same set of 10 predetermined explanatory variables. Notably, the same model works well for all countries, as the random forest attributes minimal values to country fixed effects.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用随机森林模型分析了13个发达国家35年来的房价驱动因素，发现价格动量、初始估值（房价租金比）和家庭信贷增长是主要解释变量，模型预测误差比OLS模型降低44-45%。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素驱动了13个发达国家过去35年的房价变化？
AI.motivation: 理解房价驱动因素对政策制定者和投资者至关重要，但传统线性模型可能无法捕捉复杂的非线性关系，需要更先进的机器学习方法来识别关键驱动因素及其非线性效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Breiman（2001）的随机森林理论框架，结合Shapley值进行变量重要性分析，同时考虑了房价动量理论、估值理论和信贷理论。
AI.method: 使用随机森林模型分析13个发达国家35年的面板数据，包含10个预定解释变量，采用Shapley值评估变量重要性，进行部分效应分析以识别非线性关系，并通过样本外预测测试与OLS模型比较。
AI.findings: 1. 房价增长主要受价格动量、初始估值（房价租金比）和家庭信贷增长驱动；2. 解释变量存在重要非线性效应，如CPI通胀对房价增长的影响；3. 随机森林模型比OLS模型的RMSE降低44%，MAE降低45%；4. 模型对所有国家都适用，国家固定效应影响最小。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将随机森林模型应用于跨国房价分析，拓展了机器学习在房地产经济学中的应用；2. 识别了房价驱动因素的非线性关系；3. 证明了单一模型可适用于多个国家，挑战了需要国家特定模型的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了更准确的房价预测工具；2. 帮助投资者识别关键风险因素；3. 为央行和监管机构提供信贷政策参考；4. 展示了机器学习方法在宏观经济预测中的优越性。

title: Risk-Return Asymmetry in Investor Decision Making: Evidence from the Iranian Capital Market
affiliations: and Yazd University

detail.title: Risk-Return Asymmetry in Investor Decision Making: Evidence from the Iranian Capital Market
detail.abstract: This study examines risk-return asymmetry and investor behavior in Iran's capital market. It analyzes daily data from 185 companies on Tehran Stock Exchange 2011-2024 to understand how investors react to gains and losses. The research uses a two-regime panel-data approach to find patterns during both positive and negative return periods, considering company fundamentals and market factors. The results show that in market downturns, fundamentals and downside risks have a bigger impact on returns, suggesting investors are more sensitive to losses and negative news. In rising markets, sentiment and trading activity play a larger role, showing that investors are cautious but also tend to follow trends. The data also reveals that investors take more risks when facing losses and avoid risks when making gains. Overall, the results highlight that behavioral biases strongly influence investment decisions and the importance of considering downside risks in pricing, risk management, and regulation in emerging markets. *This paper is an early version of an ongoing research project. It has not been peer-reviewed and is currently under consideration for journal submission. Comments and feedback are welcome.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了伊朗资本市场的风险收益不对称性和投资者行为，发现投资者对损失和负面消息更敏感，在下跌市场中基本面因素影响更大，而在上涨市场中情绪和交易活动作用更显著，揭示了行为偏差对投资决策的重要影响。
AI.research_question: 伊朗资本市场中投资者如何对收益和损失做出反应？风险收益不对称性如何影响投资者行为？
AI.motivation: 理解新兴市场中投资者的行为特征，特别是他们对收益和损失的不对称反应，有助于改进资产定价、风险管理和监管政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学理论，包括前景理论（损失厌恶）、投资者情绪理论、风险收益不对称性理论。
AI.method: 使用两区制面板数据方法，分析2011-2024年德黑兰证券交易所185家公司的日度数据，考虑公司基本面和市场因素。
AI.findings: 1. 市场下跌时，基本面和下行风险对收益影响更大；2. 市场上涨时，投资者情绪和交易活动作用更显著；3. 投资者在面临损失时承担更多风险，在获得收益时规避风险；4. 行为偏差对投资决策有强烈影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了行为金融理论在新兴市场的应用，验证了风险收益不对称性在伊朗资本市场的存在，深化了对投资者损失厌恶和趋势跟随行为的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊朗资本市场的资产定价、风险管理、监管政策提供实证依据，帮助投资者识别行为偏差，改进投资决策，为政策制定者提供市场稳定性的参考。

reference: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 12, 2020
title: What 'Special Purposes' Explain Cross-Border Debt Funding by Banks? Evidence from Ireland
affiliations: and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: What 'Special Purposes' Explain Cross-Border Debt Funding by Banks? Evidence from Ireland

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 12, 2020
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The factors driving debt issuance by banks are known to relate to their risk profiles. This appears to be particularly true when it comes to cross-border issuance and issuing debt through the special purpose entity (SPE) channel. Both of these areas are relatively unexplored, however, particularly the latter. We examine a key global channel, namely international banks issuing debt through Irish-resident SPEs for determinants of both the decision to issue debt and volumes issued. At the bank-level, we find that debt issuance through SPEs is consistently explained by larger bank size and higher loan loss provisioning, and, for banks from advanced economies, higher regulatory capital. At the country-level, we find spillover effects from higher levels of both capital flow and macro-prudential regulation in the bank's home country and, for banks from advanced economies, higher domestic corporate taxation was also an important determinant. Therefore, a cross-border SPE could act as a risk indicator for financial stability analysis and regulatory monitoring.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了银行通过爱尔兰特殊目的实体(SPE)发行债务的决定因素，发现银行规模、贷款损失拨备、监管资本以及母国的资本流动、宏观审慎监管和公司税率等因素会影响SPE债务发行决策和规模。跨境SPE可作为金融稳定分析和监管监测的风险指标。
AI.research_question: 银行通过爱尔兰特殊目的实体(SPE)发行跨境债务的决定因素是什么？哪些银行层面和国家层面的因素影响银行通过SPE发行债务的决策和发行规模？
AI.motivation: 银行债务发行的驱动因素与其风险状况相关，但跨境发行和通过特殊目的实体(SPE)渠道发行债务这两个领域研究相对不足，特别是后者。理解这些渠道对金融稳定分析和监管监测具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行风险管理和监管套利理论，结合资本流动、宏观审慎监管和税收政策等国家层面因素，分析银行通过SPE发行债务的动机和决定因素。
AI.method: 实证分析国际银行通过爱尔兰居民SPE发行债务的数据，采用银行层面和国家层面的变量，研究债务发行决策和发行规模的决定因素。
AI.findings: 银行层面：SPE债务发行与银行规模较大、贷款损失拨备较高相关；对发达经济体银行，还与较高的监管资本相关。国家层面：受母国资本流动水平较高和宏观审慎监管影响；对发达经济体银行，较高的国内公司税率也是重要决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了对银行债务发行渠道的理解，特别是SPE这一相对未探索的领域；深化了银行风险管理和监管套利理论在跨境金融活动中的应用；为金融稳定分析提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了监测银行风险的新指标——跨境SPE活动可作为风险预警信号；帮助政策制定者理解银行通过SPE进行监管套利的动机；为金融稳定评估和跨境监管协调提供实证依据。
